  245     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
  246         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {
  247             "message": repr(inference_data["message"]),
  248             "system_prompt": inference_data["system_prompt"],
  249         }
  250 
  251         if inference_data["caching_enabled"]:
  252             # Cache the system prompt
  253             inference_data["system_prompt"][0]["cache_control"] = {"type": "ephemeral"}
  254             # Add cache control to the last two user messages as well
  255             count = 0
  256             for message in reversed(inference_data["message"]):
  257                 if message["role"] == "user":
  258                     if count < 2:
  259                         message["content"][0]["cache_control"] = {"type": "ephemeral"}
  260                     else:
  261                         if "cache_control" in message["content"][0]:
  262                             del message["content"][0]["cache_control"]
  263                     count += 1
  264 
  265         # Need to set timeout to avoid auto-error when requesting large context length
  266         # https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python#long-requests
  267         return self.generate_with_backoff(
  268             model=self.model_name,
  269             max_tokens=self._get_max_tokens(),
  270             temperature=self.temperature,
  271             system=inference_data["system_prompt"],
  272             messages=inference_data["message"],
  273             timeout=1200,
  274         )
  275 
  276     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  277         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  278         test_entry_id: str = test_entry["id"]
  279         test_category: str = test_entry_id.rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  280 
  281         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  282 
  283         test_entry["question"][0] = system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
  284             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
  285         )
  286         # Claude takes in system prompt in a specific field, not in the message field, so we don't need to add it to the message
  287         system_prompt = extract_system_prompt(test_entry["question"][0])
  288 
  289         system_prompt = [{"type": "text", "text": system_prompt}]
  290 
  291         # Claude doesn't allow consecutive user prompts, so we need to combine them
  292         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
  293             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = combine_consecutive_user_prompts(
  294                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
  295             )
  296 
  297         test_entry_id: str = test_entry["id"]
  298         test_category: str = test_entry_id.rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  299         # caching enabled only for multi_turn category
  300         caching_enabled: bool = is_multi_turn(test_category)
  301 
  302         return {
  303             "message": [],
  304             "system_prompt": system_prompt,
  305             "caching_enabled": caching_enabled,
  306         }
  307 
  308     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  309         return {
  310             "model_responses": api_response.content[0].text,
  311             "input_token": api_response.usage.input_tokens,
  312             "output_token": api_response.usage.output_tokens,
  313         }
  314 
  315     def add_first_turn_message_prompting(
  316         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  317     ) -> dict:
  318         for message in first_turn_message:
  319             message["content"] = [{"type": "text", "text": message["content"]}]
  320         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
  321         return inference_data
  322 
  323     def _add_next_turn_user_message_prompting(
  324         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  325     ) -> dict:
  326         for message in user_message:
  327             message["content"] = [{"type": "text", "text": message["content"]}]
  328         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)
  329         return inference_data
  330 
  331     def _add_assistant_message_prompting(
  332         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  333     ) -> dict:
  334         inference_data["message"].append(
  335             {
  336                 "role": "assistant",
  337                 "content": model_response_data["model_responses"],
  338             }
  339         )
  340         return inference_data
  341 
  342     def _add_execution_results_prompting(
  343         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  344     ) -> dict:
  345         formatted_results_message = format_execution_results_prompting(
  346             inference_data, execution_results, model_response_data
  347         )
  348         inference_data["message"].append(
  349             {
  350                 "role": "user",
  351                 "content": [{"type": "text", "text": formatted_results_message}],
  352             }
  353         )
  354 
  355         return inference_data

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/cohere.py
    1 import ast
    2 import json
    3 import os
    4 import time
    5 from typing import Any
    6 
    7 import cohere
    8 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    9 from bfcl_eval.constants.type_mappings import GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI
   10 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
   11 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
   12     convert_to_tool,
   13     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   14     retry_with_backoff,
   15 )
   16 from tenacity.stop import stop_after_attempt
   17 
   18 
   19 class CohereHandler(BaseHandler):
   20     client: cohere.ClientV2
   21 
   22     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   23         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   24         self.model_style = ModelStyle.COHERE
   25         self.is_fc_model = True
   26         self.client = cohere.ClientV2(api_key=os.getenv("COHERE_API_KEY"))
   27 
   28     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   29         decoded_output = []
   30         if isinstance(result, list):
   31             for tool_call in result:
   32                 name = tool_call["tool_name"]
   33                 params = tool_call["parameters"]
   34                 decoded_output.append({name: params})
   35         return decoded_output
   36 
   37     def decode_execute(self, result):
   38         execution_list = []
   39         if isinstance(result, list):
   40             for tool_call in result:
   41                 parameter_key_value_list = []
   42                 for parameter_name, parameter_value in tool_call["parameters"].items():
   43                     parameter_key_value_list.append("{}={}".format(parameter_name, repr(parameter_value)))
   44                 execution_list.append("{}({})".format(tool_call["tool_name"], ",".join(parameter_key_value_list)))
   45         return execution_list
   46 
   47     #### FC methods ####
   48 
   49     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   50         if system_message := inference_data.get("system_message"):
   51             system_turn = [
   52                 cohere.SystemChatMessageV2(
   53                     role="system",
   54                     content=system_message,
   55                 )
   56             ]
   57         else:
   58             system_turn = []
   59         all_chat_turns = system_turn + inference_data["chat_turns"]
   60 
   61         response, latency = self.generate_with_backoff(
   62             messages=all_chat_turns,
   63             tools=[load_cohere_tool(tool=tool) for tool in inference_data["tools"]],
   64         )
   65 
   66         model_tool_calls = []
   67         chat_turn_to_append = cohere.AssistantChatMessageV2(role="assistant")
   68         response_message = response.message
   69         if response_message.tool_calls:
   70             chat_turn_to_append.tool_calls = response_message.tool_calls
   71             for tool_call in response_message.tool_calls:
   72                 model_tool_calls.append(
   73                     {
   74                         "tool_name": tool_call.function.name,
   75                         "parameters": json.loads(tool_call.function.arguments),
   76                     }
   77                 )
   78         if response_message.tool_plan:
   79             chat_turn_to_append.tool_plan = response_message.tool_plan
   80         if response_message.content:
   81             chat_turn_to_append.content = [
   82                 cohere.TextAssistantMessageContentItem(text=msg.text, type="text")
   83                 for msg in response_message.content
   84             ]
   85         if response_message.citations:
   86             chat_turn_to_append.citations = response_message.citations
   87         inference_data["chat_turns"].append(chat_turn_to_append)
   88 
   89         input_token: float | None = None
   90         output_token: float | None = None
   91         if response.usage and response.usage.billed_units:
   92             input_token = response.usage.billed_units.input_tokens
   93             output_token = response.usage.billed_units.output_tokens
   94 
   95         metadata = {
   96             "model_responses": chat_turn_to_append.content if chat_turn_to_append.content else None,
   97             "tool_calls": model_tool_calls,
   98             "chat_history": [],
   99             "input_token": input_token or 0,
  100             "output_token": output_token or 0,
  101         }
  102         return metadata, latency
  103 
  104     @retry_with_backoff(error_type=Exception, stop=stop_after_attempt(5), reraise=True)
  105     def generate_with_backoff(
  106         self,
  107         messages: list,
  108         tools: list[cohere.types.ToolV2]
  109     ) -> tuple[cohere.types.ChatResponse, float]:
  110         start_time = time.time()
  111         api_response = self.client.chat(
  112             model=self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
  113             messages=messages,
  114             tools=tools,
  115             citation_options=cohere.CitationOptions(mode="OFF"),
  116             temperature=self.temperature,
  117         )
  118         end_time = time.time()
  119 
  120         return api_response, end_time - start_time
  121 
  122     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  123         turns = []
  124         for turn_idx, turn in enumerate(test_entry["question"]):
  125             if turn_idx == 0:  # we only extract system message from the first turn
  126                 system_message = load_system_message(turn)
  127                 if system_message:
  128                     inference_data["system_message"] = system_message  # we log system message if necessary
  129             if len(turn) > 0:
  130                 turns.append(preprocess_chat_turns(turn))
  131             else:
  132                 turns.append([])  # for miss_func categories, the turn to supplement function will be empty
  133         assert len(turns) == len(test_entry["question"])
  134         test_entry["question"] = turns
  135         return inference_data
  136 
  137     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  138         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  139         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  140 
  141         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  142         tools = convert_to_tool(functions, GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI, self.model_style)
  143         inference_data["tools"] = tools
  144 
  145         return inference_data
  146 
  147     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: Any) -> dict:
  148         if len(api_response["tool_calls"]) > 0:  # non empty tool call list
  149             model_responses = api_response["tool_calls"]  # list: {"tool_name": , "parameters"}
  150         else:
  151             if isinstance(api_response["model_responses"], list):
  152                 model_responses = []
  153                 for item in api_response["model_responses"]:
  154                     if isinstance(item, cohere.types.TextAssistantMessageContentItem):
  155                         model_responses.append(item.text)
  156                     else:
  157                         model_responses.append(item)
  158                 model_responses = "\n".join(model_responses)
  159             else:
  160                 model_responses = api_response["model_responses"]
  161 
  162         return {
  163             "model_responses": model_responses,
  164             "tool_calls": api_response["tool_calls"],
  165             "chat_history": api_response["chat_history"],
  166             "input_token": api_response["input_token"],
  167             "output_token": api_response["output_token"],
  168         }
  169 
  170     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  171         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  172     ) -> dict:
  173         chat_turns = []
  174         for message in first_turn_message:
  175             message_role = message["role"]
  176             assert message_role in ["user", "assistant"], "message role must be in ['user', 'assistant']"
  177             if message_role == "user":
  178                 chat_turns.append(cohere.UserChatMessageV2(role="user", content=message["content"]))
  179             else:
  180                 chat_turns.append(
  181                     cohere.AssistantChatMessageV2(
  182                         role="assistant",
  183                         content=message["content"],
  184                     )
  185                 )
  186         inference_data["chat_turns"] = chat_turns
  187         inference_data["raw_prompt"] = []
  188         inference_data["raw_completion"] = []
  189         return inference_data
  190 
  191     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  192         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  193     ) -> dict:
  194         assert "chat_turns" in inference_data, "expected chat_turns to be present"
  195         for message in user_message:
  196             message_role = message["role"]
  197             if message_role == "user":
  198                 inference_data["chat_turns"].append(
  199                     cohere.UserChatMessageV2(role="user", content=message["content"]))
  200             elif message_role == "assistant":
  201                 inference_data["chat_turns"].append(
  202                     cohere.AssistantChatMessageV2(
  203                         role="assistant",
  204                         content=message["content"],
  205                     )
  206                 )
  207             else:
  208                 raise Exception(f"Role {message_role} is undefined!")
  209         if inference_data["chat_turns"][-1].role != "user":
  210             # if last turn is not user turn - we suffixing a user turn at the end of the conversation history
  211             inference_data["chat_turns"].append(cohere.UserChatMessageV2(role="user", content=""))
  212         return inference_data
  213 
  214     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  215         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  216     ) -> dict:
  217         # Cohere has all the messages in the chat history already, so no need to add anything here
  218         return inference_data
  219 
  220     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  221         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  222     ) -> dict:
  223         if execution_results:
  224             # non-empty execution_results, the last turn of inference_data["chat_turns"] must be a tool use turn
  225             # otherwise, do nothing
  226             assert (
  227                 inference_data["chat_turns"][-1].role == "assistant"
  228             ), "last turn must be tool use turn and from the assistant"
  229             assert inference_data["chat_turns"][-1].tool_calls, "last turn must have tool calls"
  230             assert len(inference_data["chat_turns"][-1].tool_calls) == len(
  231                 execution_results
  232             ), "Number of execution result must match number of tool calls from last turn!"
  233             tool_call_messages = []
  234             for tool_call, execution_result in zip(inference_data["chat_turns"][-1].tool_calls, execution_results):
  235                 tool_call_id = tool_call.id
  236                 try:
  237                     tool_execution_result = ast.literal_eval(execution_result)
  238                 except:
  239                     tool_execution_result = execution_result
  240                 if isinstance(tool_execution_result, dict):
  241                     if "id" in tool_execution_result:
  242                         tool_execution_result["ID"] = tool_execution_result["id"]
  243                         del tool_execution_result["id"]
  244                     result_to_render = json.dumps(tool_execution_result)
  245                 else:
  246                     result_to_render = execution_result
  247                 one_tool_call_output = cohere.ToolChatMessageV2(
  248                     tool_call_id=tool_call_id,
  249                     content=[
  250                         cohere.TextToolContent(type="text", text=result_to_render),
  251                     ],
  252                 )
  253                 tool_call_messages.append(one_tool_call_output)
  254             inference_data["chat_turns"].extend(tool_call_messages)
  255         return inference_data
  256 
  257 
  258 def load_system_message(all_messages: list[dict]):
  259     for message in all_messages:
  260         if message["role"] == "system":
  261             return message["content"]
  262     return None
  263 
  264 
  265 def preprocess_chat_turns(all_messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
  266     processed_messages: list[dict] = []
  267     for message in all_messages:
  268         if message["role"] == "system":
  269             continue  # skip system message, it has been logged in inference_data
  270         processed_messages.append(message)
  271     return processed_messages
  272 
  273 
  274 def load_cohere_tool(tool: dict):
  275     function = tool["function"]
  276     return cohere.ToolV2(
  277         type="function",
  278         function=cohere.ToolV2Function(
  279             name=function["name"],
  280             description=function["description"],
  281             parameters=function["parameters"],
  282         ),
  283     )

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/databricks.py
    1 import os
    2 import re
    3 import time
    4 
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.openai_completion import OpenAICompletionsHandler
    6 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    8     ast_parse,
    9     combine_consecutive_user_prompts,
   10     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   11     system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model,
   12 )
   13 from openai import OpenAI
   14 
   15 
   16 class DatabricksHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
   17     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   18         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   19         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Completions
   20 
   21         # NOTE: To run the Databricks model, you need to provide your own Databricks API key and your own Azure endpoint URL.
   22         self.client = OpenAI(
   23             api_key=os.getenv("DATABRICKS_API_KEY"),
   24             base_url=os.getenv("DATABRICKS_AZURE_ENDPOINT_URL"),
   25         )
   26 
   27     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   28         func = re.sub(r"'([^']*)'", r"\1", result)
   29         func = func.replace("\n    ", "")
   30         if not func.startswith("["):
   31             func = "[" + func
   32         if not func.endswith("]"):
   33             func = func + "]"
   34         if func.startswith("['"):
   35             func = func.replace("['", "[")
   36         try:
   37             decode_output = ast_parse(func, language)
   38         except:
   39             decode_output = ast_parse(result, language)
   40         return decode_output
   41 
   42     def decode_execute(self, result, language="Python"):
   43         func = re.sub(r"'([^']*)'", r"\1", result)
   44         func = func.replace("\n    ", "")
   45         if not func.startswith("["):
   46             func = "[" + func
   47         if not func.endswith("]"):
   48             func = func + "]"
   49         if func.startswith("['"):
   50             func = func.replace("['", "[")
   51         try:
   52             decode_output = ast_parse(func, language)
   53         except:
   54             decode_output = ast_parse(result, language)
   55         execution_list = []
   56         for function_call in decode_output:
   57             for key, value in function_call.items():
   58                 execution_list.append(
   59                     f"{key}({','.join([f'{k}={repr(v)}' for k, v in value.items()])})"
   60                 )
   61         return execution_list
   62 
   63     #### Prompting methods ####
   64 
   65     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
   66         message = inference_data["message"]
   67         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(inference_data["message"])}
   68 
   69         start_time = time.time()
   70         api_response = self.client.chat.completions.create(
   71             messages=message,
   72             model=self.model_name,
   73             temperature=self.temperature,
   74         )
   75         end_time = time.time()
   76 
   77         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   78 
   79     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   80         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   81         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   82 
   83         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
   84 
   85         test_entry["question"][0] = system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
   86             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
   87         )
   88 
   89         # Databricks doesn't allow consecutive user prompts, so we need to combine them
   90         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
   91             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = combine_consecutive_user_prompts(
   92                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
   93             )
   94 
   95         return {"message": []}

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/deepseek.py
    1 import json
    2 import os
    3 import time
    4 from typing import Any
    5 
    6 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.openai_completion import OpenAICompletionsHandler
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    8 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    9     combine_consecutive_user_prompts,
   10     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   11     retry_with_backoff,
   12     system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model,
   13 )
   14 from openai import OpenAI, RateLimitError
   15 from overrides import override
   16 
   17 
   18 class DeepSeekAPIHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
   19     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   20         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   21         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI
   22         self.client = OpenAI(
   23             base_url="https://api.deepseek.com", api_key=os.getenv("DEEPSEEK_API_KEY")
   24         )
   25 
   26     # The deepseek API is unstable at the moment, and will frequently give empty responses, so retry on JSONDecodeError is necessary
   27     @retry_with_backoff(error_type=[RateLimitError, json.JSONDecodeError])
   28     def generate_with_backoff(self, **kwargs):
   29         """
   30         Per the DeepSeek API documentation:
   31         https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/rate_limit
   32 
   33         DeepSeek API does NOT constrain user's rate limit. We will try out best to serve every request.
   34         But please note that when our servers are under high traffic pressure, you may receive 429 (Rate Limit Reached) or 503 (Server Overloaded). When this happens, please wait for a while and retry.
   35 
   36         Thus, backoff is still useful for handling 429 and 503 errors.
   37         """
   38         start_time = time.time()
   39         api_response = self.client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
   40         end_time = time.time()
   41 
   42         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   43 
   44     @override
   45     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   46         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   47         tools = inference_data["tools"]
   48         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message), "tools": tools}
   49 
   50         # Source https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
   51         # This will need to be updated if newer models are released.
   52         if "DeepSeek-V3" in self.model_name:
   53             api_model_name = "deepseek-chat"
   54         elif "DeepSeek-R1" in self.model_name:
   55             api_model_name = "deepseek-reasoner"
   56         else:
   57             raise ValueError(
   58                 f"Model name {self.model_name} not yet supported in this method"
   59             )
   60 
   61         if len(tools) > 0:
   62             return self.generate_with_backoff(
   63                 model=api_model_name,
   64                 messages=message,
   65                 tools=tools,
   66                 temperature=self.temperature,
   67             )
   68         else:
   69             return self.generate_with_backoff(
   70                 model=api_model_name,
   71                 messages=message,
   72                 temperature=self.temperature,
   73             )
   74 
   75     @override
   76     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
   77         """
   78         This method is intended to be used by the `DeepSeek-R1` models. If used for other models, you will need to modify the code accordingly.
   79 
   80         Reasoning models don't support temperature parameter
   81         https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/reasoning_model
   82 
   83         `DeepSeek-R1` should use `deepseek-reasoner` as the model name in the API
   84         https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing
   85         """
   86         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   87         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message)}
   88 
   89         if "DeepSeek-R1" in self.model_name:
   90             api_model_name = "deepseek-reasoner"
   91         else:
   92             raise ValueError(
   93                 f"Model name {self.model_name} not yet supported in this method"
   94             )
   95 
   96         return self.generate_with_backoff(
   97             model=api_model_name,
   98             messages=message,
   99         )
  100 
  101     @override
  102     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  103         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  104         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  105 
  106         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  107 
  108         test_entry["question"][0] = system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
  109             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
  110         )
  111 
  112         # 'deepseek-reasoner does not support successive user messages, so we need to combine them
  113         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
  114             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = combine_consecutive_user_prompts(
  115                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
  116             )
  117 
  118         return {"message": []}
  119 
  120     @override
  121     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: Any) -> dict:
  122         """
  123         DeepSeek does not take reasoning content in next turn chat history, for both prompting and function calling mode.
  124         Error: Error code: 400 - {'error': {'message': 'The reasoning_content is an intermediate result for display purposes only and will not be included in the context for inference. Please remove the reasoning_content from your message to reduce network traffic.', 'type': 'invalid_request_error', 'param': None, 'code': 'invalid_request_error'}}
  125         """
  126         response_data = super()._parse_query_response_prompting(api_response)
  127         self._add_reasoning_content_if_available_prompting(api_response, response_data)
  128         return response_data
  129 
  130     @override
  131     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  132         """
  133         DeepSeek does not take reasoning content in next turn chat history, for both prompting and function calling mode.
  134         Error: Error code: 400 - {'error': {'message': 'The reasoning_content is an intermediate result for display purposes only and will not be included in the context for inference. Please remove the reasoning_content from your message to reduce network traffic.', 'type': 'invalid_request_error', 'param': None, 'code': 'invalid_request_error'}}
  135         """
  136         response_data = super()._parse_query_response_FC(api_response)
  137         self._add_reasoning_content_if_available_FC(api_response, response_data)
  138         return response_data

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/fireworks.py
    1 import os
    2 import time
    3 
    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.openai_completion import OpenAICompletionsHandler
    6 from openai import OpenAI
    7 
    8 
    9 class FireworksHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
   10     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   11         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   12         self.model_style = ModelStyle.FIREWORK_AI
   13 
   14         self.client = OpenAI(
   15             base_url="https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1",
   16             api_key=os.getenv("FIREWORKS_API_KEY"),
   17         )
   18 
   19     #### FC methods ####
   20 
   21     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   22         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   23         tools = inference_data["tools"]
   24         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": message, "tools": tools}
   25 
   26         start_time = time.time()
   27         if len(tools) > 0:
   28             api_response = self.client.chat.completions.create(
   29                 messages=message,
   30                 model=f"accounts/fireworks/models/{self.model_name.replace('-FC', '')}",
   31                 temperature=self.temperature,
   32                 tools=tools,
   33             )
   34         else:
   35             api_response = self.client.chat.completions.create(
   36                 messages=message,
   37                 model=f"accounts/fireworks/models/{self.model_name.replace('-FC', '')}",
   38                 temperature=self.temperature,
   39             )
   40         end_time = time.time()
   41 
   42         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   43 
   44     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   45         return super()._pre_query_processing_FC(inference_data, test_entry)
   46 
   47     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   48         return super()._compile_tools(inference_data, test_entry)
   49 
   50     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
   51         try:
   52             model_responses = [
   53                 {func_call.function.name: func_call.function.arguments}
   54                 for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
   55             ]
   56             tool_calls = [
   57                 tool_call.model_dump()
   58                 for tool_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
   59             ]
   60         except:
   61             model_responses = api_response.choices[0].message.content
   62             tool_calls = []
   63 
   64         return {
   65             "model_responses": model_responses,
   66             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": tool_calls,
   67             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
   68             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
   69         }
   70 
   71     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
   72         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
   73     ) -> dict:
   74         return super().add_first_turn_message_FC(inference_data, first_turn_message)
   75 
   76     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
   77         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
   78     ) -> dict:
   79         return super()._add_next_turn_user_message_FC(inference_data, user_message)
   80 
   81     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
   82         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
   83     ) -> dict:
   84         inference_data["message"].append(
   85             {
   86                 "role": "assistant",
   87                 "content": "",
   88                 "tool_calls": model_response_data[
   89                     "model_responses_message_for_chat_history"
   90                 ],
   91             }
   92         )
   93         return inference_data
   94 
   95     def _add_execution_results_FC(
   96         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
   97     ) -> dict:
   98         # Fireworks don’t support parallel and nested function calling, but we still support the code logic here for future use
   99         for execution_result in execution_results:
  100             tool_message = {
  101                 "role": "tool",
  102                 "content": execution_result,
  103             }
  104             inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
  105 
  106         return inference_data

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/gemini.py
    1 import os
    2 import time
    3 
    4 from bfcl_eval.constants.type_mappings import GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    6 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    8     convert_to_tool,
    9     default_decode_ast_prompting,
   10     default_decode_execute_prompting,
   11     extract_system_prompt,
   12     format_execution_results_prompting,
   13     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   14     retry_with_backoff,
   15     system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model,
   16 )
   17 from google import genai
   18 from google.genai import errors as genai_errors
   19 from google.genai.types import (
   20     AutomaticFunctionCallingConfig,
   21     Content,
   22     GenerateContentConfig,
   23     Part,
   24     ThinkingConfig,
   25     Tool,
   26 )
   27 
   28 
   29 class GeminiHandler(BaseHandler):
   30     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   31         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   32         self.model_style = ModelStyle.GOOGLE
   33         api_key = os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
   34         if not api_key:
   35             raise ValueError(
   36                 "GOOGLE_API_KEY environment variable must be set for Gemini models"
   37             )
   38         self.client = genai.Client(api_key=api_key)
   39 
   40     @staticmethod
   41     def _substitute_prompt_role(prompts: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
   42         # Allowed roles: user, model
   43         for prompt in prompts:
   44             if prompt["role"] == "user":
   45                 prompt["role"] = "user"
   46             elif prompt["role"] == "assistant":
   47                 prompt["role"] = "model"
   48 
   49         return prompts
   50 
   51     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   52         if "FC" not in self.model_name:
   53             result = result.replace("```tool_code\n", "").replace("\n```", "")
   54             return default_decode_ast_prompting(result, language)
   55         else:
   56             if type(result) is not list:
   57                 result = [result]
   58             return result
   59 
   60     def decode_execute(self, result):
   61         if "FC" not in self.model_name:
   62             result = result.replace("```tool_code\n", "").replace("\n```", "")
   63             return default_decode_execute_prompting(result)
   64         else:
   65             func_call_list = []
   66             for function_call in result:
   67                 for func_name, func_args in function_call.items():
   68                     func_call_list.append(
   69                         f"{func_name}({','.join([f'{k}={repr(v)}' for k, v in func_args.items()])})"
   70                     )
   71             return func_call_list
   72 
   73     # We can't retry on ClientError because it's too broad.
   74     # Both rate limit and invalid function description will trigger google.genai.errors.ClientError
   75     @retry_with_backoff(error_message_pattern=r".*RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.*")
   76     def generate_with_backoff(self, **kwargs):
   77         start_time = time.time()
   78         api_response = self.client.models.generate_content(**kwargs)
   79         end_time = time.time()
   80 
   81         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   82 
   83     #### FC methods ####
   84 
   85     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   86         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {
   87             "message": repr(inference_data["message"]),
   88             "tools": inference_data["tools"],
   89             "system_prompt": inference_data.get("system_prompt", None),
   90         }
   91 
   92         config = GenerateContentConfig(
   93             temperature=self.temperature,
   94             automatic_function_calling=AutomaticFunctionCallingConfig(disable=True),
   95             thinking_config=ThinkingConfig(include_thoughts=True),
   96         )
   97 
   98         if "system_prompt" in inference_data:
   99             config.system_instruction = inference_data["system_prompt"]
  100 
  101         if len(inference_data["tools"]) > 0:
  102             config.tools = [Tool(function_declarations=inference_data["tools"])]
  103 
  104         return self.generate_with_backoff(
  105             model=self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
  106             contents=inference_data["message"],
  107             config=config,
  108         )
  109 
  110     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  111 
  112         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
  113             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = self._substitute_prompt_role(
  114                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
  115             )
  116 
  117         inference_data["message"] = []
  118 
  119         system_prompt = extract_system_prompt(test_entry["question"][0])
  120         if system_prompt:
  121             inference_data["system_prompt"] = system_prompt
  122         return inference_data
  123 
  124     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  125         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  126         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  127 
  128         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  129         tools = convert_to_tool(functions, GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI, self.model_style)
  130 
  131         inference_data["tools"] = tools
  132 
  133         return inference_data
  134 
  135     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  136         tool_call_func_names = []
  137         fc_parts = []
  138         text_parts = []
  139         reasoning_content = []
  140 
  141         if (
  142             len(api_response.candidates) > 0
  143             and api_response.candidates[0].content
  144             and api_response.candidates[0].content.parts
  145             and len(api_response.candidates[0].content.parts) > 0
  146         ):
  147             response_function_call_content = api_response.candidates[0].content
  148 
  149             for part in api_response.candidates[0].content.parts:
  150                 # part.function_call is a FunctionCall object, so it will always be True even if it contains no function call
  151                 # So we need to check if the function name is empty `""` to determine if Gemini returned a function call
  152                 if part.function_call and part.function_call.name:
  153                     part_func_name = part.function_call.name
  154                     part_func_args = part.function_call.args
  155                     part_func_args_dict = {k: v for k, v in part_func_args.items()}
  156 
  157                     fc_parts.append({part_func_name: part_func_args_dict})
  158                     tool_call_func_names.append(part_func_name)
  159                 # Aggregate reasoning content
  160                 elif part.thought:
  161                     reasoning_content.append(part.text)
  162                 else:
  163                     text_parts.append(part.text)
  164 
  165         else:
  166             response_function_call_content = Content(
  167                 role="model",
  168                 parts=[
  169                     Part(text="The model did not return any response."),
  170                 ],
  171             )
  172 
  173         model_responses = fc_parts if fc_parts else text_parts
  174 
  175         return {
  176             "model_responses": model_responses,
  177             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": response_function_call_content,
  178             "tool_call_func_names": tool_call_func_names,
  179             "reasoning_content": "\n".join(reasoning_content),
  180             "input_token": api_response.usage_metadata.prompt_token_count,
  181             "output_token": api_response.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count,
  182         }
  183 
  184     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  185         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  186     ) -> dict:
  187         for message in first_turn_message:
  188             inference_data["message"].append(
  189                 Content(
  190                     role=message["role"],
  191                     parts=[
  192                         Part(text=message["content"]),
  193                     ],
  194                 )
  195             )
  196         return inference_data
  197 
  198     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  199         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  200     ) -> dict:
  201         return self.add_first_turn_message_FC(inference_data, user_message)
  202 
  203     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  204         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  205     ) -> dict:
  206         inference_data["message"].append(
  207             model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  208         )
  209         return inference_data
  210 
  211     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  212         self,
  213         inference_data: dict,
  214         execution_results: list[str],
  215         model_response_data: dict,
  216     ) -> dict:
  217         # Tool response needs to be converted to Content object as well.
  218         # One Content object for all tool responses.
  219         tool_response_parts = []
  220         for execution_result, tool_call_func_name in zip(
  221             execution_results, model_response_data["tool_call_func_names"]
  222         ):
  223             tool_response_parts.append(
  224                 Part.from_function_response(
  225                     name=tool_call_func_name,
  226                     response={
  227                         "result": execution_result,
  228                     },
  229                 )
  230             )
  231 
  232         tool_response_content = Content(role="user", parts=tool_response_parts)
  233         inference_data["message"].append(tool_response_content)
  234 
  235         return inference_data
  236 
  237     #### Prompting methods ####
  238 
  239     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
  240         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {
  241             "message": repr(inference_data["message"]),
  242             "system_prompt": inference_data.get("system_prompt", None),
  243         }
  244 
  245         config = GenerateContentConfig(
  246             temperature=self.temperature,
  247             thinking_config=ThinkingConfig(include_thoughts=True),
  248         )
  249 
  250         if "system_prompt" in inference_data:
  251             config.system_instruction = inference_data["system_prompt"]
  252 
  253         api_response = self.generate_with_backoff(
  254             model=self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
  255             contents=inference_data["message"],
  256             config=config,
  257         )
  258         return api_response
  259 
  260     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  261         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  262         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  263 
  264         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  265 
  266         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
  267             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = self._substitute_prompt_role(
  268                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
  269             )
  270 
  271         test_entry["question"][0] = system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
  272             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
  273         )
  274         # Gemini has system prompt in a specific field
  275         system_prompt = extract_system_prompt(test_entry["question"][0])
  276 
  277         if system_prompt:
  278             return {"message": [], "system_prompt": system_prompt}
  279         else:
  280             return {"message": []}
  281 
  282     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  283         if (
  284             len(api_response.candidates) > 0
  285             and api_response.candidates[0].content
  286             and api_response.candidates[0].content.parts
  287             and len(api_response.candidates[0].content.parts) > 0
  288         ):
  289             assert (
  290                 len(api_response.candidates[0].content.parts) <= 2
  291             ), f"Length of response parts should be less than or equal to 2. {api_response.candidates[0].content.parts}"
  292 
  293             model_responses = ""
  294             reasoning_content = ""
  295             for part in api_response.candidates[0].content.parts:
  296                 if part.thought:
  297                     reasoning_content = part.text
  298                 else:
  299                     model_responses = part.text
  300 
  301         else:
  302             model_responses = "The model did not return any response."
  303 
  304         return {
  305             "model_responses": model_responses,
  306             "reasoning_content": reasoning_content,
  307             "input_token": api_response.usage_metadata.prompt_token_count,
  308             "output_token": api_response.usage_metadata.candidates_token_count,
  309         }
  310 
  311     def add_first_turn_message_prompting(
  312         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  313     ) -> dict:
  314         for message in first_turn_message:
  315             inference_data["message"].append(
  316                 Content(
  317                     role=message["role"],
  318                     parts=[
  319                         Part(text=message["content"]),
  320                     ],
  321                 )
  322             )
  323         return inference_data
  324 
  325     def _add_next_turn_user_message_prompting(
  326         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  327     ) -> dict:
  328         return self.add_first_turn_message_prompting(inference_data, user_message)
  329 
  330     def _add_assistant_message_prompting(
  331         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  332     ) -> dict:
  333         inference_data["message"].append(
  334             Content(
  335                 role="model",
  336                 parts=[
  337                     Part(text=model_response_data["model_responses"]),
  338                 ],
  339             )
  340         )
  341         return inference_data
  342 
  343     def _add_execution_results_prompting(
  344         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  345     ) -> dict:
  346         formatted_results_message = format_execution_results_prompting(
  347             inference_data, execution_results, model_response_data
  348         )
  349         tool_message = Content(
  350             role="user",
  351             parts=[
  352                 Part(text=formatted_results_message),
  353             ],
  354         )
  355         inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
  356         return inference_data

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/gorilla.py
    1 import json
    2 import time
    3 
    4 import requests
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    6 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import ast_parse
    8 
    9 
   10 class GorillaHandler(BaseHandler):
   11     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   12         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   13         self.model_style = ModelStyle.Gorilla
   14         self.is_fc_model = True
   15 
   16     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   17         func = "[" + result + "]"
   18         decoded_output = ast_parse(func, language)
   19         return decoded_output
   20 
   21     def decode_execute(self, result):
   22         func = "[" + result + "]"
   23         decoded_output = ast_parse(func)
   24         execution_list = []
   25         for function_call in decoded_output:
   26             for key, value in function_call.items():
   27                 execution_list.append(
   28                     f"{key}({','.join([f'{k}={repr(v)}' for k, v in value.items()])})"
   29                 )
   30         return execution_list
   31 
   32     #### FC methods ####
   33 
   34     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   35         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {
   36             "message": inference_data["message"],
   37             "tools": inference_data["tools"],
   38         }
   39         requestData = {
   40             "model": self.model_name,
   41             "messages": inference_data["message"],
   42             "functions": inference_data["tools"],
   43             "temperature": self.temperature,
   44         }
   45         url = "https://luigi.millennium.berkeley.edu:443/v1/chat/completions"
   46 
   47         start_time = time.time()
   48         api_response = requests.post(
   49             url,
   50             headers={
   51                 "Content-Type": "application/json",
   52                 "Authorization": "EMPTY",  # Hosted for free with ❤️ from UC Berkeley
   53             },
   54             data=json.dumps(requestData),
   55         )
   56         end_time = time.time()
   57 
   58         return api_response.json(), end_time - start_time
   59 
   60     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   61         inference_data["message"] = []
   62         return inference_data
   63 
   64     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   65         # Gorilla OpenFunctions does not require any pre-processing
   66         inference_data["tools"] = test_entry["function"]
   67 
   68         return inference_data
   69 
   70     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
   71 
   72         return {
   73             "model_responses": api_response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"],
   74             "input_token": api_response["usage"]["prompt_tokens"],
   75             "output_token": api_response["usage"]["completion_tokens"],
   76         }
   77 
   78     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
   79         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
   80     ) -> dict:
   81         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
   82         return inference_data
   83 
   84     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
   85         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
   86     ) -> dict:
   87         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)
   88         return inference_data
   89 
   90     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
   91         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
   92     ) -> dict:
   93         inference_data["message"].append(
   94             {
   95                 "role": "assistant",
   96                 "content": model_response_data["model_responses"],
   97             }
   98         )
   99         return inference_data
  100 
  101     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  102         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  103     ) -> dict:
  104         for execution_result in execution_results:
  105             tool_message = {
  106                 "role": "tool",
  107                 "content": execution_result,
  108             }
  109             inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
  110 
  111         return inference_data

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/ling.py
    1 import json
    2 import os
    3 import time
    4 
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.openai_completion import OpenAICompletionsHandler
    6 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    8     combine_consecutive_user_prompts,
    9     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   10     retry_with_backoff,
   11     system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model,
   12 )
   13 from openai import OpenAI, RateLimitError
   14 from overrides import override
   15 
   16 
   17 class LingAPIHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
   18     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   19         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   20         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Completions
   21         api_url = "https://bailingchat.alipay.com"
   22         self.client = OpenAI(base_url=api_url, api_key=os.getenv("LING_API_KEY"))
   23 
   24     @retry_with_backoff(error_type=[RateLimitError, json.JSONDecodeError])
   25     def generate_with_backoff(self, **kwargs):
   26         start_time = time.time()
   27         api_response = self.client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
   28         end_time = time.time()
   29 
   30         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   31 
   32     @override
   33     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
   34         """
   35         Call the model API in prompting mode to get the response.
   36         Return the response object that can be used to feed into the decode method.
   37         """
   38         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   39         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message)}
   40 
   41         if "Ling/ling-lite-v1.5" in self.model_name:
   42             api_name = "Ling-lite-1.5-250604"
   43         else:
   44             raise ValueError(
   45                 f"Model name {self.model_name} not yet supported in this method"
   46             )
   47 
   48         return self.generate_with_backoff(
   49             model=api_name,
   50             messages=message,
   51         )
   52 
   53     @override
   54     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   55         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   56         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   57 
   58         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
   59 
   60         test_entry["question"][0] = system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
   61             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
   62         )
   63 
   64         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
   65             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = combine_consecutive_user_prompts(
   66                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
   67             )
   68 
   69         return {"message": []}
   70 
   71     @override
   72     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
   73         response_data = super()._parse_query_response_prompting(api_response)
   74         self._add_reasoning_content_if_available_prompting(api_response, response_data)
   75         return response_data

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/mining.py
    1 import json
    2 import os
    3 
    4 import re
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    6 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    7     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing
    8 )
    9 from openai import OpenAI
   10 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.openai_completion import OpenAICompletionsHandler
   11 
   12 class MiningHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
   13     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   14         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   15         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Completions
   16         self.client = OpenAI(
   17             base_url= os.getenv("MINING_BASE_URL"),
   18             api_key=os.getenv("MINING_API_KEY"),
   19         )
   20 
   21     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   22         decoded_output = []
   23         for invoked_function in result:
   24             name = invoked_function["name"]
   25             params = invoked_function["arguments"]
   26             decoded_output.append({name: params})
   27         return decoded_output
   28 
   29     def decode_execute(self, result):
   30         too_call_format = []
   31         for tool_call in result:
   32             if isinstance(tool_call, dict):
   33                 name = tool_call.get("name", "")
   34                 arguments = tool_call.get("arguments", {})
   35                 args_str = ", ".join(
   36                     [f"{key}={repr(value)}" for key, value in arguments.items()]
   37                 )
   38                 too_call_format.append(f"{name}({args_str})")
   39         return too_call_format
   40 
   41     #### Prompting methods ####
   42 
   43     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   44         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   45         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   46 
   47         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
   48 
   49         test_entry["question"][0] = self.mining_system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
   50             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
   51         )
   52         return {"message": []}
   53 
   54     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
   55         match = re.search(r'<tool_calls>\n(.*?)\n</tool_calls>', api_response.choices[0].message.content, re.DOTALL)
   56         tool_calls = api_response.choices[0].message.content
   57         if match:
   58            tool_calls =  match.group(1).strip()
   59         try:
   60             tool_calls = tool_calls.replace("'",'"')
   61             tool_calls = json.loads(tool_calls)
   62         except:
   63             pass
   64         message = api_response.choices[0].message
   65         return {
   66             "model_responses": tool_calls,
   67             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": message,
   68             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
   69             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
   70         }
   71 
   72     def mining_system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(self,prompts, function_docs, test_category):
   73         system_pre="""You are a function calling AI model. 
   74 You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags.
   75 You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query. 
   76 Don't make assumptions about what values to plug into functions.
   77 
   78 Here are the available tools:
   79 <tools> 
   80 {}
   81 </tools>
   82 """
   83         system_suffix = """
   84 
   85 Use the following pydantic model json schema for each tool call you will make: 
   86 {"title": "FunctionCalls", "type": "array", "properties": {"arguments": {"title": "Arguments", "type": "object"}, "name": {"title": "Name", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["arguments", "name"]}
   87 
   88 At each turn, you should try your best to complete the tasks requested by the user within the current turn. Continue to output functions to call until you have fulfilled the user's request to the best of your ability. Once you have no more functions to call, the system will consider the current turn complete and proceed to the next turn or task.
   89 
   90 # Output Format
   91 If you find suitable function, for each function call return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_calls></tool_calls> XML tags as follows:
   92 <think>
   93 {reasoning process here}
   94 </think>
   95 <tool_calls>
   96 {[tool_call]}
   97 </tool_calls>
   98 
   99 If no suitable function is found, just respond with XML tags as follows:
  100 <think>
  101 {reasoning process here}
  102 </think>
  103 <tool_calls>
  104 []
  105 </tool_calls>"""
  106         assert type(prompts) == list
  107 
  108         system_prompt = system_pre.format(function_docs)+system_suffix
  109 
  110         # System prompt must be in the first position
  111         # If the question comes with a system prompt, append its content at the end of the chat template.
  112         if prompts[0]["role"] == "system":
  113             prompts[0]["content"] = system_prompt + "\n\n" + prompts[0]["content"]
  114         # Otherwise, use the system prompt template to create a new system prompt.
  115         else:
  116             prompts.insert(
  117                 0,
  118                 {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
  119             )
  120 
  121         return prompts

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/mistral.py
    1 import json
    2 import os
    3 import time
    4 
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    6 from bfcl_eval.constants.type_mappings import GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    8 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    9     ast_parse,
   10     convert_to_function_call,
   11     convert_to_tool,
   12     format_execution_results_prompting,
   13     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   14     system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model,
   15 )
   16 from mistralai import Mistral
   17 
   18 
   19 class MistralHandler(BaseHandler):
   20     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   21         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   22         self.model_style = ModelStyle.Mistral
   23 
   24         self.client = Mistral(api_key=os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY"))
   25 
   26     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   27         if "FC" in self.model_name:
   28             decoded_output = []
   29             for invoked_function in result:
   30                 name = list(invoked_function.keys())[0]
   31                 params = json.loads(invoked_function[name])
   32                 decoded_output.append({name: params})
   33             return decoded_output
   34         else:
   35             func = result
   36             func = func.replace("\\_", "_")
   37             if not func.startswith("["):
   38                 func = "[" + func
   39             if not func.endswith("]"):
   40                 func = func + "]"
   41             decoded_output = ast_parse(func, language)
   42             return decoded_output
   43 
   44     def decode_execute(self, result):
   45         if "FC" in self.model_name:
   46             function_call = convert_to_function_call(result)
   47             return function_call
   48         else:
   49             func = result
   50             func = func.replace("\\_", "_")
   51             decode_output = ast_parse(func)
   52             execution_list = []
   53             for function_call in decode_output:
   54                 for key, value in function_call.items():
   55                     execution_list.append(
   56                         f"{key}({','.join([f'{k}={repr(v)}' for k, v in value.items()])})"
   57                     )
   58             return execution_list
   59 
   60     #### FC methods ####
   61 
   62     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   63         message = inference_data["message"]
   64         tool = inference_data["tools"]
   65         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {
   66             "message": message,
   67             "tools": tool,
   68         }
   69 
   70         start_time = time.time()
   71         api_response = self.client.chat.complete(
   72             model=self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
   73             messages=message,
   74             tools=tool,
   75             temperature=self.temperature,
   76         )
   77         end_time = time.time()
   78 
   79         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   80 
   81     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   82         inference_data["message"] = []
   83         return inference_data
   84 
   85     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   86         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   87         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   88 
   89         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
   90         tools = convert_to_tool(functions, GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI, self.model_style)
   91 
   92         inference_data["tools"] = tools
   93 
   94         return inference_data
   95 
   96     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
   97         try:
   98             model_responses = [
   99                 {func_call.function.name: func_call.function.arguments}
  100                 for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
  101             ]
  102             tool_call_func_names = [
  103                 func_call.function.name
  104                 for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
  105             ]
  106             tool_call_ids = [
  107                 func_call.id for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
  108             ]
  109         except:
  110             model_responses = api_response.choices[0].message.content
  111             tool_call_func_names = []
  112             tool_call_ids = []
  113 
  114         return {
  115             "model_responses": model_responses,
  116             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": api_response.choices[0].message,
  117             "tool_call_func_names": tool_call_func_names,
  118             "tool_call_ids": tool_call_ids,
  119             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
  120             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
  121         }
  122 
  123     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  124         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  125     ) -> dict:
  126         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
  127         return inference_data
  128 
  129     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  130         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  131     ) -> dict:
  132         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)
  133         return inference_data
  134

  139             model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  140         )
  141         return inference_data
  142 
  143     def _add_execution_results_FC(

  154                 "content": execution_result,
  155                 "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
  156             }
  157             inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
