FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/nemotron.py
    1 import re
    2 
    3 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.nvidia import NvidiaHandler
    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    5     combine_consecutive_user_prompts,
    6     convert_system_prompt_into_user_prompt,
    7     default_decode_ast_prompting,
    8     default_decode_execute_prompting,
    9     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   10 )
   11 from overrides import override
   12 
   13 
   14 class NemotronHandler(NvidiaHandler):
   15     """Handler for the LLaMA 3.1 Nemotron Ultra 253B v1 model.
   16 
   17     This handler extends NvidiaHandler to support the Nemotron model's XML-based
   18     function calling format. The model expects:
   19     - <TOOLCALL>[function_calls]</TOOLCALL> for function calls
   20     - <AVAILABLE_TOOLS>{functions}</AVAILABLE_TOOLS> for function documentation
   21     """
   22 
   23     def _format_system_prompt(self, prompts, function_docs, test_category):
   24         """Format the system prompt in the Nemotron-specific XML format."""
   25 
   26         system_prompt_template = """You are an expert in composing functions. You are given a question and a set of possible functions.
   27 Based on the question, you will need to make one or more function/tool calls to achieve the purpose.
   28 If none of the function can be used, point it out. If the given question lacks the parameters required by the function,
   29 also point it out. You should only return the function call in tools call sections.
   30 
   31 If you decide to invoke any of the function(s), you MUST put it in the format of <TOOLCALL>[func_name1(params_name1=params_value1, params_name2=params_value2...), func_name2(params)]</TOOLCALL>
   32 
   33 You SHOULD NOT include any other text in the response.
   34 Here is a list of functions in JSON format that you can invoke.
   35 
   36 <AVAILABLE_TOOLS>{functions}</AVAILABLE_TOOLS>
   37 
   38 {user_prompt}"""
   39 
   40         # Extract the first user message content (if any) and remove it from the list.
   41         user_prompt = ""
   42         for idx, msg in enumerate(prompts):
   43             if msg["role"] == "user":
   44                 user_prompt = msg["content"]
   45                 # Delete the user message – it will be folded into the system prompt.
   46                 prompts.pop(idx)
   47                 break
   48 
   49         system_prompt = system_prompt_template.format(
   50             functions=function_docs, user_prompt=user_prompt
   51         )
   52 
   53         # Insert the system prompt at the beginning of the list.
   54         prompts.insert(0, {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt})
   55 
   56         return prompts
   57 
   58     @override
   59     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   60         """Process the input query and format it for the Nemotron model."""
   61         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   62         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   63 
   64         # Pre-process functions based on language
   65         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
   66 
   67         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
   68             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = convert_system_prompt_into_user_prompt(
   69                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
   70             )
   71             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = combine_consecutive_user_prompts(
   72                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
   73             )
   74 
   75         test_entry["question"][0] = self._format_system_prompt(
   76             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
   77         )
   78 
   79         # Return empty message list - messages will be added incrementally
   80         return {"message": []}
   81 
   82     @override
   83     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   84         """Extract function calls from the Nemotron XML format."""
   85         # Extract content between TOOLCALL tags
   86         toolcall_match = re.search(r"<TOOLCALL>(.*?)</TOOLCALL>", result, re.DOTALL)
   87         if not toolcall_match:
   88             return []
   89 
   90         # Get the function call string
   91         func_call_str = toolcall_match.group(1)
   92 
   93         return default_decode_ast_prompting(func_call_str, language)
   94 
   95     @override
   96     def decode_execute(self, result, language="Python"):
   97         """Convert Nemotron response to executable function calls."""
   98         # Extract content between TOOLCALL tags
   99         toolcall_match = re.search(r"<TOOLCALL>(.*?)</TOOLCALL>", result, re.DOTALL)
  100         if not toolcall_match:
  101             return []
  102 
  103         # Get the function call string
  104         func_call_str = toolcall_match.group(1)
  105 
  106         return default_decode_execute_prompting(func_call_str, language)

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/nexus.py
    1 import time
    2 
    3 import requests
    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    6 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    7     ast_parse,
    8     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
    9 )
   10 
   11 
   12 class NexusHandler(BaseHandler):
   13     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   14         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   15         self.model_style = ModelStyle.NEXUS
   16         self.is_fc_model = True
   17 
   18     @staticmethod
   19     def _generate_functions_from_dict(func_dicts):
   20         func_template = """
   21     Function:
   22     def {func_name}({func_args}) -> None:
   23         \"\"\"
   24         {description}
   25 
   26         Parameters:
   27         {param_descriptions}
   28         \"\"\"
   29 
   30     """
   31 
   32         functions = []
   33         for func_dict in func_dicts:
   34             func_name = func_dict["name"]
   35             description = func_dict["description"]
   36             parameters = func_dict["parameters"]["properties"]
   37             required_params = func_dict["parameters"].get("required", [])
   38 
   39             func_args_list = []
   40             param_descriptions = []
   41 
   42             for param, details in parameters.items():
   43                 param_type = details["type"]
   44                 if "enum" in details:
   45                     param_type = (
   46                         f"""String[{', '.join(f"'{e}'" for e in details['enum'])}]"""
   47                     )
   48 
   49                 param_type = (
   50                     param_type.replace("string", "str")
   51                     .replace("number", "float")
   52                     .replace("integer", "int")
   53                     .replace("object", "dict")
   54                     .replace("array", "list")
   55                     .replace("boolean", "bool")
   56                 )
   57 
   58                 type_hint = param_type
   59 
   60                 if param in required_params:
   61                     func_args_list.append(f"{param}: {type_hint}")
   62                 else:
   63                     func_args_list.append(f"{param}: {type_hint} = None")
   64 
   65                 param_description = f"{param} ({param_type}): {details.get('description', 'No description available. Please make a good guess.')}"
   66 
   67                 if "enum" in details:
   68                     param_description += f""". Choose one of {', '.join(f"'{e}'" for e in details['enum'])}."""
   69 
   70                 if param not in required_params:
   71                     param_description += " (Optional)"
   72                 param_descriptions.append(param_description)
   73 
   74             func_args = ", ".join(func_args_list)
   75             param_descriptions_str = "\n    ".join(param_descriptions)
   76 
   77             function_str = func_template.format(
   78                 func_name=func_name,
   79                 func_args=func_args,
   80                 description=description,
   81                 param_descriptions=param_descriptions_str,
   82             )
   83 
   84             functions.append(function_str)
   85 
   86         functions.append(
   87             '''
   88     Function:
   89     def out_of_domain(user_query: str) -> str:
   90         """
   91         This function is designed to handle out-of-domain queries from the user.
   92         If the user provides any input user query that is out of the domain of the other APIs provided above,
   93         this function should be used with the input user query as the string.
   94 
   95         - user_query (str): The input string that is out of domain.
   96 
   97         Returns nothing.
   98         """
   99 
  100             '''
  101         )
  102 
  103         return functions
  104 
  105     def _format_raven_function(self, user_prompts, functions):
  106         """
  107         Nexus-Raven requires a specific format for the function description.
  108         This function formats the function description in the required format.
  109         """
  110         raven_prompt = "\n".join(functions) + "\n\n"
  111         raven_prompt += "Setting: Allowed to issue multiple calls with semicolon\n"
  112         for user_prompt in user_prompts:
  113             raven_prompt += f"{user_prompt['role']}: {user_prompt['content']}\n"
  114 
  115         raven_prompt += f"<human_end>"
  116 
  117         return raven_prompt
  118 
  119     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
  120         if result.endswith(";"):
  121             result = result[:-1]
  122         result = result.replace(";", ",")
  123         func = "[" + result + "]"
  124         decoded_output = ast_parse(func, language)
  125         if "out_of_domain" in result:
  126             return "irrelevant"
  127 
  128         return decoded_output
  129 
  130     def decode_execute(self, result):
  131         if result.endswith(";"):
  132             result = result[:-1]
  133         result = result.replace(";", ",")
  134         func = "[" + result + "]"
  135         decoded_output = ast_parse(func)
  136         execution_list = []
  137         for function_call in decoded_output:
  138             for key, value in function_call.items():
  139                 execution_list.append(
  140                     f"{key}({','.join([f'{k}={repr(v)}' for k, v in value.items()])})"
  141                 )
  142         return execution_list
  143 
  144     #### FC methods ####
  145 
  146     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
  147         API_URL = "http://nexusraven.nexusflow.ai"
  148         headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
  149         prompt = self._format_raven_function(
  150             inference_data["message"], inference_data["tools"]
  151         )
  152         payload = {
  153             "inputs": prompt,
  154             "parameters": {
  155                 "temperature": self.temperature,
  156                 "stop": ["<bot_end>"],
  157                 "do_sample": False,
  158                 "return_full_text": False,
  159             },
  160         }
  161         start_time = time.time()
  162         api_response = requests.post(
  163             "http://nexusraven.nexusflow.ai", headers=headers, json=payload
  164         )
  165         end_time = time.time()
  166 
  167         return api_response.json(), end_time - start_time
  168 
  169     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  170         inference_data["message"] = []
  171         return inference_data
  172 
  173     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  174         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  175         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  176 
  177         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  178         # Nexus requires functions to be in a specific format
  179         inference_data["tools"] = self._generate_functions_from_dict(functions)
  180 
  181         return inference_data
  182 
  183     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  184         return {
  185             "model_responses": api_response[0]["generated_text"]
  186             .replace("Call:", "")
  187             .strip(),
  188             "input_token": "N/A",
  189             "output_token": "N/A",
  190         }
  191 
  192     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  193         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  194     ) -> dict:
  195         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
  196         return inference_data
  197 
  198     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  199         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  200     ) -> dict:
  201         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)
  202         return inference_data
  203 
  204     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  205         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  206     ) -> dict:
  207         inference_data["message"].append(
  208             {
  209                 "role": "assistant",
  210                 "content": model_response_data["model_responses"],
  211             }
  212         )
  213         return inference_data
  214 
  215     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  216         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  217     ) -> dict:
  218         for execution_result in execution_results:
  219             tool_message = {
  220                 "role": "tool",
  221                 "content": execution_result,
  222             }
  223             inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
  224 
  225         return inference_data

    1 import os
    2 import time
    3 
    4 import boto3
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    6 from bfcl_eval.constants.type_mappings import GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    8 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    9     combine_consecutive_user_prompts,
   10     convert_to_function_call,

   14     retry_with_backoff,

   16 
   17 
   18 class NovaHandler(BaseHandler):
   19     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   20         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   21         self.model_style = ModelStyle.AMAZON
   22         self.is_fc_model = True
   23         self.client = boto3.client(
   24             service_name="bedrock-runtime",
   25             region_name="us-east-1",  # Currently only available in us-east-1
   26             aws_access_key_id=os.getenv("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"),
   27             aws_secret_access_key=os.getenv("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"),
   28         )
   29 
   30     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   31         if type(result) != list:
   32             return []
   33         return result
   34 
   35     def decode_execute(self, result):
   36         if type(result) != list:
   37             return []
   38         return convert_to_function_call(result)
   39 
   40     @retry_with_backoff(error_message_pattern=r".*\(ThrottlingException\).*")
   41     def generate_with_backoff(self, **kwargs):
   42         start_time = time.time()
   43         api_response = self.client.converse(**kwargs)
   44         end_time = time.time()
   45 
   46         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   47 
   48     #### FC methods ####
   49 
   50     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   51         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   52         tools = inference_data["tools"]
   53 
   54         if "system_prompt" in inference_data:
   55             system_prompt = inference_data["system_prompt"]
   56         else:
   57             system_prompt = []
   58 
   59         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {
   60             "message": repr(message),
   61             "tools": tools,
   62             "system_prompt": system_prompt,
   63         }
   64 
   65         if len(tools) > 0:
   66             # toolConfig requires minimum number of 1 item.
   67             return self.generate_with_backoff(
   68                 modelId=f"us.amazon.{self.model_name.replace('.', ':')}",
   69                 messages=message,
   70                 system=system_prompt,
   71                 inferenceConfig={"temperature": self.temperature},
   72                 toolConfig={"tools": tools},
   73             )
   74         else:
   75             return self.generate_with_backoff(
   76                 modelId=f"us.amazon.{self.model_name.replace('.', ':')}",
   77                 messages=message,
   78                 system=system_prompt,
   79                 inferenceConfig={"temperature": self.temperature},
   80             )
   81 
   82     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   83         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
   84             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = combine_consecutive_user_prompts(
   85                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
   86             )
   87 
   88         inference_data["message"] = []
   89 
   90         system_prompt = extract_system_prompt(test_entry["question"][0])
   91         if system_prompt:
   92             inference_data["system_prompt"] = [{"text": system_prompt}]
   93 
   94         return inference_data
   95 
   96     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   97         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   98         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   99 
  100         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  101         tools = convert_to_tool(functions, GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI, self.model_style)
  102 
  103         inference_data["tools"] = tools
  104 
  105         return inference_data
  106 
  107     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  108         model_responses_message_for_chat_history = api_response["output"]["message"]
  109 
  110         if api_response["stopReason"] == "tool_use":
  111             model_responses = []
  112             tool_call_ids = []
  113             """
  114             Note: Not every response will have a toolUse, so we skip any content that does not have a toolUse
  115             Example API response:
  116             "output": {
  117                 "message": {
  118                     "role": "assistant",
  119                     "content": [
  120                         {"text": "`"},
  121                         {
  122                             "toolUse": {
  123                                 "toolUseId": "tooluse_kF0BECcNSd6WITS9W4afbQ",
  124                                 "name": "calculate_triangle_area",
  125                                 "input": {"base": 10, "height": 5},
  126                             }
  127                         },
  128                         {"text": "`"},
  129                     ],
  130                 }
  131             },
  132             """
  133             for func_call in api_response["output"]["message"]["content"]:
  134                 if "toolUse" not in func_call:
  135                     continue
  136 
  137                 func_call = func_call["toolUse"]
  138                 func_name = func_call["name"]
  139                 func_args = func_call["input"]
  140                 model_responses.append({func_name: func_args})
  141                 tool_call_ids.append(func_call["toolUseId"])
  142 
  143         else:
  144             model_responses = api_response["output"]["message"]["content"][0]["text"]
  145             tool_call_ids = []
  146 
  147         return {
  148             "model_responses": model_responses,
  149             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": model_responses_message_for_chat_history,
  150             "tool_call_ids": tool_call_ids,
  151             "input_token": api_response["usage"]["inputTokens"],
  152             "output_token": api_response["usage"]["outputTokens"],
  153         }
  154 
  155     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  156         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  157     ) -> dict:
  158         for message in first_turn_message:
  159             message["content"] = [{"text": message["content"]}]
  160         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
  161         return inference_data
  162 
  163     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  164         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  165     ) -> dict:
  166         for message in user_message:
  167             message["content"] = [{"text": message["content"]}]
  168         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)
  169         return inference_data
  170 
  171     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  172         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  173     ) -> dict:
  174         inference_data["message"].append(
  175             model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  176         )
  177         return inference_data
  178 
  179     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  180         self,
  181         inference_data: dict,
  182         execution_results: list[str],
  183         model_response_data: dict,
  184     ) -> dict:
  185         # Nova use the `user` role for the tool result message
  186         tool_message = {
  187             "role": "user",
  188             "content": [],
  189         }
  190         for execution_result, tool_call_id in zip(
  191             execution_results, model_response_data["tool_call_ids"]
  192         ):
  193             tool_message["content"].append(
  194                 {
  195                     "toolResult": {
  196                         "toolUseId": tool_call_id,
  197                         # Nova models supports json or text content
  198                         # Our pipeline force execution results to be text for all models
  199                         # So we will just use text here to be consistent
  200                         "content": [{"text": execution_result}],
  201                     }
  202                 }
  203             )
  204 
  205         inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
  206 
  207         return inference_data

    1 import os
    2 
    3 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.openai_completion import OpenAICompletionsHandler
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    6     ast_parse,
    7     combine_consecutive_user_prompts,
    8     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
    9     system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model,
   10 )
   11 from openai import OpenAI
   12 
   13 
   14 class NvidiaHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
   15     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   16         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   17         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Completions
   18         self.client = OpenAI(
   19             base_url="https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1",
   20             api_key=os.getenv("NVIDIA_API_KEY"),
   21         )
   22 
   23     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   24         result = result.replace("\n", "")
   25         if not result.startswith("["):
   26             result = "[" + result
   27         if not result.endswith("]"):
   28             result = result + "]"
   29         if result.startswith("['"):
   30             result = result.replace("['", "[")
   31             result = result.replace("', '", ", ")
   32             result = result.replace("','", ", ")
   33         if result.endswith("']"):
   34             result = result.replace("']", "]")
   35         decode_output = ast_parse(result, language)
   36         return decode_output
   37 
   38     def decode_execute(self, result, language="Python"):
   39         result = result.replace("\n", "")
   40         if not result.startswith("["):
   41             result = "[" + result
   42         if not result.endswith("]"):
   43             result = result + "]"
   44         if result.startswith("['"):
   45             result = result.replace("['", "[")
   46             result = result.replace("', '", ", ")
   47             result = result.replace("','", ", ")
   48         if result.endswith("']"):
   49             result = result.replace("']", "]")
   50         decode_output = ast_parse(result, language)
   51         execution_list = []
   52         for function_call in decode_output:
   53             for key, value in function_call.items():
   54                 execution_list.append(
   55                     f"{key}({','.join([f'{k}={repr(v)}' for k, v in value.items()])})"
   56                 )
   57         return execution_list
   58 
   59     #### Prompting methods ####
   60 
   61     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   62         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   63         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   64 
   65         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
   66 
   67         test_entry["question"][0] = system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
   68             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
   69         )
   70 
   71         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
   72             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = combine_consecutive_user_prompts(
   73                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
   74             )
   75 
   76         return {"message": []}

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/openai_completion.py
    1 import json
    2 import os
    3 import time
    4 from typing import Any
    5 
    6 from bfcl_eval.constants.type_mappings import GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    8 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    9 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
   10     convert_to_function_call,
   11     convert_to_tool,
   12     default_decode_ast_prompting,
   13     default_decode_execute_prompting,
   14     format_execution_results_prompting,
   15     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   16     retry_with_backoff,
   17     system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model,
   18 )
   19 from openai import OpenAI, RateLimitError
   20 
   21 
   22 class OpenAICompletionsHandler(BaseHandler):
   23     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   24         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   25         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Completions
   26         self.client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
   27 
   28     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   29         if "FC" in self.model_name or self.is_fc_model:
   30             decoded_output = []
   31             for invoked_function in result:
   32                 name = list(invoked_function.keys())[0]
   33                 params = json.loads(invoked_function[name])
   34                 decoded_output.append({name: params})
   35             return decoded_output
   36         else:
   37             return default_decode_ast_prompting(result, language)
   38 
   39     def decode_execute(self, result):
   40         if "FC" in self.model_name or self.is_fc_model:
   41             return convert_to_function_call(result)
   42         else:
   43             return default_decode_execute_prompting(result)
   44 
   45     @retry_with_backoff(error_type=RateLimitError)
   46     def generate_with_backoff(self, **kwargs):
   47         start_time = time.time()
   48         api_response = self.client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
   49         end_time = time.time()
   50 
   51         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   52 
   53     #### FC methods ####
   54 
   55     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   56         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   57         tools = inference_data["tools"]
   58         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message), "tools": tools}
   59 
   60         kwargs = {
   61             "messages": message,
   62             "model": self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
   63             "temperature": self.temperature,
   64             "store": False,
   65         }
   66 
   67         if len(tools) > 0:
   68             kwargs["tools"] = tools
   69 
   70         return self.generate_with_backoff(**kwargs)
   71 
   72     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   73         inference_data["message"] = []
   74         return inference_data
   75 
   76     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   77         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   78         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   79 
   80         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
   81         tools = convert_to_tool(functions, GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI, self.model_style)
   82 
   83         inference_data["tools"] = tools
   84 
   85         return inference_data
   86 
   87     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
   88         try:
   89             model_responses = [
   90                 {func_call.function.name: func_call.function.arguments}
   91                 for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
   92             ]
   93             tool_call_ids = [
   94                 func_call.id for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
   95             ]
   96         except:
   97             model_responses = api_response.choices[0].message.content
   98             tool_call_ids = []
   99 
  100         model_responses_message_for_chat_history = api_response.choices[0].message
  101 
  102         return {
  103             "model_responses": model_responses,
  104             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": model_responses_message_for_chat_history,
  105             "tool_call_ids": tool_call_ids,
  106             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
  107             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
  108         }
  109 
  110     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  111         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  112     ) -> dict:
  113         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
  114         return inference_data
  115 
  116     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  117         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  118     ) -> dict:
  119         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)
  120         return inference_data
  121 
  122     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  123         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  124     ) -> dict:
  125         inference_data["message"].append(
  126             model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  127         )
  128         return inference_data
  129 
  130     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  131         self,
  132         inference_data: dict,
  133         execution_results: list[str],
  134         model_response_data: dict,
  135     ) -> dict:
  136         # Add the execution results to the current round result, one at a time
  137         for execution_result, tool_call_id in zip(
  138             execution_results, model_response_data["tool_call_ids"]
  139         ):
  140             tool_message = {
  141                 "role": "tool",
  142                 "content": execution_result,
  143                 "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
  144             }
  145             inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
  146 
  147         return inference_data
  148 
  149     def _add_reasoning_content_if_available_FC(
  150         self, api_response: Any, response_data: dict
  151     ) -> None:
  152         """
  153         OpenAI models don't show reasoning content in the api response,
  154         but many other models that use the OpenAI interface do, such as DeepSeek and Grok.
  155         This method is included here to avoid code duplication.
  156 
  157         These models often don't take reasoning content in the chat history for next turn.
  158         Thus, this method saves reasoning content to response_data (for local result file) if present in the response,
  159         but does not include it in the chat history.
  160         """
  161         # Original assistant message object (contains `reasoning_content` on DeepSeek).
  162         message = api_response.choices[0].message
  163 
  164         # Preserve tool_call information but strip the unsupported `reasoning_content` field before inserting into chat history.
  165         if getattr(message, "tool_calls", None):
  166             assistant_message = {
  167                 "role": "assistant",
  168                 "content": message.content,
  169                 "tool_calls": [
  170                     {
  171                         "id": tool_call.id,
  172                         "type": tool_call.type,
  173                         "function": {
  174                             "name": tool_call.function.name,
  175                             "arguments": tool_call.function.arguments,
  176                         },
  177                     }
  178                     for tool_call in message.tool_calls
  179                 ],
  180             }
  181             response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"] = assistant_message
  182 
  183         # If no tool_calls, we still need to strip reasoning_content.
  184         elif hasattr(message, "reasoning_content"):
  185             response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"] = {
  186                 "role": "assistant",
  187                 "content": message.content,
  188             }
  189 
  190         # Capture the reasoning trace so it can be logged to the local result file.
  191         if hasattr(message, "reasoning_content"):
  192             response_data["reasoning_content"] = message.reasoning_content
  193 
  194     #### Prompting methods ####
  195 
  196     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
  197         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(inference_data["message"])}
  198 
  199         return self.generate_with_backoff(
  200             messages=inference_data["message"],
  201             model=self.model_name,
  202             temperature=self.temperature,
  203             store=False,
  204         )
  205 
  206     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  207         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  208         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  209 
  210         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  211 
  212         test_entry["question"][0] = system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
  213             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
  214         )
  215 
  216         return {"message": []}
  217 
  218     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  219         return {
  220             "model_responses": api_response.choices[0].message.content,
  221             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": api_response.choices[0].message,
  222             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
  223             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
  224         }
  225 
  226     def add_first_turn_message_prompting(
  227         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]

  229         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)

  232     def _add_next_turn_user_message_prompting(

  236         return inference_data

  238     def _add_assistant_message_prompting(

  241         inference_data["message"].append(
  242             model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  243         )
  244         return inference_data
  245 
  246     def _add_execution_results_prompting(
  247         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  248     ) -> dict:
  249         formatted_results_message = format_execution_results_prompting(
  250             inference_data, execution_results, model_response_data
  251         )
  252         inference_data["message"].append(
  253             {"role": "user", "content": formatted_results_message}
  254         )
  255 
  256         return inference_data
  257 
  258     def _add_reasoning_content_if_available_prompting(
  259         self, api_response: Any, response_data: dict
  260     ) -> None:
  261         """
  262         OpenAI models don't show reasoning content in the api response,
  263         but many other models that use the OpenAI interface do, such as DeepSeek and Grok.
  264         This method is included here to avoid code duplication.
  265 
  266         These models often don't take reasoning content in the chat history for next turn.
  267         Thus, this method saves reasoning content to response_data (for local result file) if present in the response,
  268         but does not include it in the chat history.
  269         """
  270         message = api_response.choices[0].message
  271         if hasattr(message, "reasoning_content"):
  272             response_data["reasoning_content"] = message.reasoning_content
  273             # Reasoning content should not be included in the chat history
  274             response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"] = {
  275                 "role": "assistant",
  276                 "content": str(response_data["model_responses"]),
  277             }

    1 import json
    2 import os
    3 import time
    4 
    5 from bfcl_eval.constants.type_mappings import GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI
    6 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    8 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    9     convert_to_function_call,
   10     convert_to_tool,
   11     default_decode_ast_prompting,
   12     default_decode_execute_prompting,
   13     format_execution_results_prompting,
   14     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   15     retry_with_backoff,

   18 from openai import OpenAI, RateLimitError
   19 from openai.types.responses import Response
   20 
   21 
   22 class OpenAIResponsesHandler(BaseHandler):
   23     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   24         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   25         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Responses
   26         self.client = OpenAI(api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
   27 
   28     @staticmethod
   29     def _substitute_prompt_role(prompts: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
   30         # OpenAI allows `system` role in the prompt, but it is meant for "messages added by OpenAI"
   31         # For our use case, it is recommended to use `developer` role instead.
   32         # See https://model-spec.openai.com/2025-04-11.html#definitions
   33         for prompt in prompts:
   34             if prompt["role"] == "system":
   35                 prompt["role"] = "developer"
   36 
   37         return prompts
   38 
   39     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   40         if "FC" in self.model_name or self.is_fc_model:
   41             decoded_output = []
   42             for invoked_function in result:
   43                 name = list(invoked_function.keys())[0]
   44                 params = json.loads(invoked_function[name])
   45                 decoded_output.append({name: params})
   46             return decoded_output
   47         else:
   48             return default_decode_ast_prompting(result, language)
   49 
   50     def decode_execute(self, result):
   51         if "FC" in self.model_name or self.is_fc_model:
   52             return convert_to_function_call(result)
   53         else:
   54             return default_decode_execute_prompting(result)
   55 
   56     @retry_with_backoff(error_type=RateLimitError)
   57     def generate_with_backoff(self, **kwargs):
   58         start_time = time.time()
   59         api_response = self.client.responses.create(**kwargs)
   60         end_time = time.time()
   61 
   62         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   63 
   64     #### FC methods ####
   65 
   66     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   67         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   68         tools = inference_data["tools"]
   69 
   70         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {
   71             "message": repr(message),
   72             "tools": tools,
   73         }
   74 
   75         kwargs = {
   76             "input": message,
   77             "model": self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
   78             "store": False,
   79             "include": ["reasoning.encrypted_content"],
   80             "reasoning": {"summary": "auto"},
   81         }
   82 
   83         # OpenAI reasoning models don't support temperature parameter
   84         if "o3" not in self.model_name and "o4-mini" not in self.model_name:
   85             kwargs["temperature"] = self.temperature
   86 
   87         if len(tools) > 0:
   88             kwargs["tools"] = tools
   89 
   90         return self.generate_with_backoff(**kwargs)
   91 
   92     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   93         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
   94             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = self._substitute_prompt_role(
   95                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
   96             )
   97 
   98         inference_data["message"] = []
   99 
  100         return inference_data
  101 
  102     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  103         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  104         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  105 
  106         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  107         tools = convert_to_tool(functions, GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI, self.model_style)
  108 
  109         inference_data["tools"] = tools
  110 
  111         return inference_data
  112 
  113     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: Response) -> dict:
  114         model_responses = []
  115         tool_call_ids = []
  116 
  117         for func_call in api_response.output:
  118             if func_call.type == "function_call":
  119                 model_responses.append({func_call.name: func_call.arguments})
  120                 tool_call_ids.append(func_call.call_id)
  121 
  122         if not model_responses:  # If there are no function calls
  123             model_responses = api_response.output_text
  124 
  125         # OpenAI reasoning models don't show full reasoning content in the api response,
  126         # but only a summary of the reasoning content.
  127         reasoning_content = ""
  128         for item in api_response.output:
  129             if item.type == "reasoning":
  130                 for summary in item.summary:
  131                     reasoning_content += summary.text + "\n"
  132 
  133         return {
  134             "model_responses": model_responses,
  135             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": api_response.output,
  136             "tool_call_ids": tool_call_ids,
  137             "reasoning_content": reasoning_content,
  138             "input_token": api_response.usage.input_tokens,
  139             "output_token": api_response.usage.output_tokens,
  140         }
  141 
  142     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  143         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  144     ) -> dict:
  145         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
  146         return inference_data
  147 
  148     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  149         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  150     ) -> dict:
  151         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)
  152         return inference_data
  153 
  154     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  155         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  156     ) -> dict:
  157         inference_data["message"].extend(
  158             model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  159         )
  160         return inference_data
  161 
  162     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  163         self,
  164         inference_data: dict,
  165         execution_results: list[str],
  166         model_response_data: dict,
  167     ) -> dict:
  168         # Add the execution results to the current round result, one at a time
  169         for execution_result, tool_call_id in zip(
  170             execution_results, model_response_data["tool_call_ids"]
  171         ):
  172             tool_message = {
  173                 "type": "function_call_output",
  174                 "call_id": tool_call_id,
  175                 "output": execution_result,
  176             }
  177             inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
  178 
  179         return inference_data
  180 
  181     #### Prompting methods ####
  182 
  183     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
  184         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(inference_data["message"])}
  185 
  186         kwargs = {
  187             "input": inference_data["message"],
  188             "model": self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
  189             "store": False,
  190             "include": ["reasoning.encrypted_content"],
  191             "reasoning": {"summary": "auto"},
  192         }
  193 
  194         # OpenAI reasoning models don't support temperature parameter
  195         if "o3" not in self.model_name and "o4-mini" not in self.model_name:
  196             kwargs["temperature"] = self.temperature
  197 
  198         return self.generate_with_backoff(**kwargs)
  199 
  200     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  201         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  202         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  203 
  204         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  205 
  206         test_entry["question"][0] = system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model(
  207             test_entry["question"][0], functions, test_category
  208         )
  209 
  210         for round_idx in range(len(test_entry["question"])):
  211             test_entry["question"][round_idx] = self._substitute_prompt_role(
  212                 test_entry["question"][round_idx]
  213             )
  214 
  215         return {"message": []}
  216 
  217     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: Response) -> dict:
  218         # OpenAI reasoning models don't show full reasoning content in the api response,
  219         # but only a summary of the reasoning content.
  220         reasoning_content = ""
  221         for item in api_response.output:
  222             if item.type == "reasoning":
  223                 for summary in item.summary:
  224                     reasoning_content += summary.text + "\n"
  225 
  226         return {
  227             "model_responses": api_response.output_text,
  228             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": api_response.output,
  229             "reasoning_content": reasoning_content,
  230             "input_token": api_response.usage.input_tokens,
  231             "output_token": api_response.usage.output_tokens,
  232         }
  233

  235         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  236     ) -> dict:
  237         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
  238         return inference_data
  239

  241         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]

  243         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/qwen.py
    1 import os
    2 from typing import Any
    3 
    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.openai_completion import OpenAICompletionsHandler
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    6 from openai import OpenAI
    7 from overrides import override
    8 from qwen_agent.llm import get_chat_model
    9 import time
   10 
   11 class QwenAPIHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
   12     """
   13     This is the OpenAI-compatible API handler with streaming enabled.
   14 
   15     For Qwen's hosted service, the QwQ series, and Qwen3 series with reasoning enabled only support streaming response for both prompting and FC mode.
   16     So to make things simple, we will just use streaming response for all Qwen model variants.
   17 
   18     """
   19 
   20     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   21         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   22         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Completions
   23         self.client = OpenAI(
   24             base_url="https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1",
   25             api_key=os.getenv("QWEN_API_KEY"),
   26         )
   27 
   28     #### FC methods ####
   29 
   30     @override
   31     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   32         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   33         tools = inference_data["tools"]
   34         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message), "tools": tools}
   35 
   36         return self.generate_with_backoff(
   37             messages=inference_data["message"],
   38             model=self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
   39             tools=tools,
   40             parallel_tool_calls=True,
   41             extra_body={
   42                 "enable_thinking": True
   43             },
   44             stream=True,
   45             stream_options={
   46                 "include_usage": True
   47             },  # retrieving token usage for stream response
   48         )
   49 
   50     @override
   51     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: Any) -> dict:
   52 
   53         reasoning_content = ""
   54         answer_content = ""
   55         tool_info = []
   56         for chunk in api_response:
   57             if not chunk.choices:
   58                 continue
   59 
   60             delta = chunk.choices[0].delta
   61 
   62             if hasattr(delta, "reasoning_content") and delta.reasoning_content is not None:
   63                 reasoning_content += delta.reasoning_content
   64 
   65             if hasattr(delta, "content") and delta.content:
   66                 answer_content += delta.content
   67 
   68             if hasattr(delta, "tool_calls") and delta.tool_calls:
   69                 for tool_call in delta.tool_calls:
   70                     # Index for parallel tool calls
   71                     index = tool_call.index
   72 
   73                     # Dynamically extend the tool info storage list
   74                     while len(tool_info) <= index:
   75                         tool_info.append({})
   76 
   77                     # Aggregate the streaming chunks of each field
   78                     if tool_call.id:
   79                         tool_info[index]["id"] = (
   80                             tool_info[index].get("id", "") + tool_call.id
   81                         )
   82                     if tool_call.function and tool_call.function.name:
   83                         tool_info[index]["name"] = (
   84                             tool_info[index].get("name", "") + tool_call.function.name
   85                         )
   86                     if tool_call.function and tool_call.function.arguments:
   87                         tool_info[index]["arguments"] = (
   88                             tool_info[index].get("arguments", "")
   89                             + tool_call.function.arguments
   90                         )
   91 
   92         tool_call_ids = []
   93         for item in tool_info:
   94             tool_call_ids.append(item["id"])
   95 
   96         if len(tool_info) > 0:
   97             # Build tool_calls structure required by OpenAI-compatible API
   98             tool_calls_for_history = []
   99             for item in tool_info:
  100                 tool_calls_for_history.append(
  101                     {
  102                         "id": item["id"],
  103                         "type": "function",
  104                         "function": {
  105                             "name": item["name"],
  106                             "arguments": item["arguments"],
  107                         },
  108                     }
  109                 )
  110 
  111             model_response = [{item["name"]: item["arguments"]} for item in tool_info]
  112             model_response_message_for_chat_history = {
  113                 "role": "assistant",
  114                 "content": None,
  115                 "tool_calls": tool_calls_for_history,
  116             }
  117             # Attach reasoning content so that it can be passed to the next turn
  118             if reasoning_content:
  119                 model_response_message_for_chat_history["reasoning_content"] = reasoning_content
  120         else:
  121             model_response = answer_content
  122             model_response_message_for_chat_history = {
  123                 "role": "assistant",
  124                 "content": answer_content,
  125             }
  126             # Attach reasoning content so that it can be passed to the next turn
  127             if reasoning_content:
  128                 model_response_message_for_chat_history["reasoning_content"] = reasoning_content
  129 
  130         response_data = {
  131             "model_responses": model_response,
  132             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": model_response_message_for_chat_history,
  133             "reasoning_content": reasoning_content,
  134             "tool_call_ids": tool_call_ids,
  135             # chunk is the last chunk of the stream response
  136             "input_token": chunk.usage.prompt_tokens,
  137             "output_token": chunk.usage.completion_tokens,
  138         }
  139 
  140         if not reasoning_content:
  141             del response_data["reasoning_content"]
  142 
  143         return response_data
  144 
  145     #### Prompting methods ####
  146 
  147     @override
  148     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
  149         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
  150         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message)}
  151 
  152         return self.generate_with_backoff(
  153             messages=inference_data["message"],
  154             model=self.model_name,
  155             extra_body={
  156                 "enable_thinking": True
  157             },
  158             stream=True,
  159             stream_options={
  160                 "include_usage": True
  161             },  # retrieving token usage for stream response
  162         )
  163 
  164     @override
  165     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: Any) -> dict:
  166 
  167         reasoning_content = ""
  168         answer_content = ""
  169         for chunk in api_response:
  170             if not chunk.choices:
  171                 continue
  172 
  173             delta = chunk.choices[0].delta
  174 
  175             if hasattr(delta, "reasoning_content") and delta.reasoning_content is not None:
  176                 reasoning_content += delta.reasoning_content
  177 
  178             if hasattr(delta, "content") and delta.content:
  179                 answer_content += delta.content
  180 
  181         response_data = {
  182             "model_responses": answer_content,
  183             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": {
  184                 "role": "assistant",
  185                 "content": answer_content,
  186             },
  187             "reasoning_content": reasoning_content,
  188             # chunk is the last chunk of the stream response
  189             "input_token": chunk.usage.prompt_tokens,
  190             "output_token": chunk.usage.completion_tokens,
  191         }
  192 
  193         # Attach reasoning content to the assistant message for the next turn if present
  194         if reasoning_content:
  195             response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"][
  196                 "reasoning_content"
  197             ] = reasoning_content
  198 
  199         if not reasoning_content:
  200             del response_data["reasoning_content"]
  201 
  202         return response_data
  203 
  204 
  205 
  206 class QwenAgentThinkHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
  207 
  208     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
  209         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
  210         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Completions
  211         """
  212         Note: Need to start vllm server first with command:
  213         vllm serve xxx \
  214             --served-model-name xxx \
  215             --port 8000 \
  216             --rope-scaling '{"rope_type":"yarn","factor":2.0,"original_max_position_embeddings":32768}' \
  217             --max-model-len 65536
  218         """
  219         
  220         self.llm = get_chat_model({
  221         'model': model_name,  # name of the model served by vllm server
  222         'model_type': 'oai',
  223         'model_server':'http://localhost:8000/v1', # can be replaced with server host
  224         'api_key': "none",
  225         'generate_cfg': {
  226             'fncall_prompt_type': 'nous',
  227             'extra_body': {
  228                 'chat_template_kwargs': {
  229                     'enable_thinking': True
  230                 }
  231             },
  232             "thought_in_content": True,
  233             'temperature': 0.6,
  234             'top_p': 0.95,
  235             'top_k': 20,
  236             'repetition_penalty': 1.0,
  237             'presence_penalty': 0.0,
  238             'max_input_tokens': 58000,
  239             'timeout': 1000,
  240             'max_tokens': 16384
  241         }
  242     })
  243 
  244     #### FC methods ####
  245     @override
  246     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
  247         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
  248         tools = inference_data["tools"]
  249         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message), "tools": tools}
  250 
  251         start_time = time.time()
  252         if len(tools) > 0:
  253             responses = None
  254             for resp in self.llm.quick_chat_oai(message, tools):
  255                 responses = resp  # 保留最后一个完整响应
  256                 
  257         else:
  258             responses = None
  259             for resp in self.llm.quick_chat_oai(message):
  260                 responses = resp
  261         end_time = time.time()
  262         
  263         return responses, end_time-start_time
  264     
  265     @override
  266     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  267         try:
  268             model_responses = [
  269                 {func_call['function']['name']: func_call['function']['arguments']}
  270                 for func_call in api_response["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"]
  271             ]
  272             tool_call_ids = [
  273                 func_call['function']['name'] for func_call in api_response["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"]
  274             ]
  275         except:
  276             model_responses = api_response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
  277             tool_call_ids = []
  278         
  279         response_data = {
  280             "model_responses": model_responses,
  281             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": api_response["choices"][0]["message"],
  282             "tool_call_ids": tool_call_ids,
  283             "input_token": api_response.get("usage", {}).get("prompt_tokens", 0),
  284             "output_token": api_response.get("usage", {}).get("completion_tokens", 0),
  285         }
  286         return response_data
  287         
  288 
  289     
  290     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  291         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  292     ) -> dict:
  293         
  294         
  295         if isinstance(model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"], list):
  296             inference_data["message"]+=model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  297         else:
  298             inference_data["message"].append(
  299                 model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  300             )
  301 
  302         return inference_data
  303 
  304
