FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/writer.py
    1 import os
    2 import time
    3 
    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.api_inference.openai_completion import OpenAICompletionsHandler
    6 from writerai import Writer
    7 
    8 
    9 class WriterHandler(OpenAICompletionsHandler):
   10     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   11         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   12         self.model_style = ModelStyle.WRITER
   13         self.client = Writer(api_key=os.getenv("WRITER_API_KEY"))
   14         self.is_fc_model = True
   15 
   16     #### FC methods ####
   17 
   18     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   19         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   20         tools = inference_data["tools"]
   21         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message), "tools": tools}
   22 
   23         start_time = time.time()
   24         if len(tools) > 0:
   25             api_response = self.client.chat.chat(
   26                 messages=message,
   27                 model=self.model_name,
   28                 temperature=self.temperature,
   29                 tools=tools,
   30                 tool_choice="auto",
   31             )
   32         else:
   33             api_response = self.client.chat.chat(
   34                 messages=message,
   35                 model=self.model_name,
   36                 temperature=self.temperature,
   37             )
   38         end_time = time.time()
   39 
   40         return api_response, end_time - start_time

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/api_inference/yi.py
    1 import json
    2 import os
    3 import time
    4 
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.base_handler import BaseHandler
    6 from bfcl_eval.constants.type_mappings import GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI
    7 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
    8 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    9     convert_to_function_call,
   10     convert_to_tool,
   11     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
   12 )
   13 from openai import OpenAI
   14 
   15 
   16 class YiHandler(BaseHandler):
   17     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   18         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   19         self.model_style = ModelStyle.OpenAI_Completions
   20         self.base_url = "https://api.01.ai/v1"
   21         self.client = OpenAI(base_url=self.base_url, api_key=os.getenv("YI_API_KEY"))
   22 
   23     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   24         decoded_output = []
   25         for invoked_function in result:
   26             name = list(invoked_function.keys())[0]
   27             params = json.loads(invoked_function[name])
   28             decoded_output.append({name: params})
   29 
   30         return decoded_output
   31 
   32     def decode_execute(self, result):
   33         function_call = convert_to_function_call(result)
   34         return function_call
   35 
   36     #### FC methods ####
   37 
   38     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
   39         message: list[dict] = inference_data["message"]
   40         tools = inference_data["tools"]
   41         inference_data["inference_input_log"] = {"message": repr(message), "tools": tools}
   42 
   43         start_time = time.time()
   44         if len(tools) > 0:
   45             api_response = self.client.chat.completions.create(
   46                 messages=message,
   47                 model=self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
   48                 temperature=self.temperature,
   49                 tools=tools,
   50             )
   51         else:
   52             api_response = self.client.chat.completions.create(
   53                 messages=message,
   54                 model=self.model_name.replace("-FC", ""),
   55                 temperature=self.temperature,
   56             )
   57         end_time = time.time()
   58 
   59         return api_response, end_time - start_time
   60 
   61     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   62         inference_data["message"] = []
   63         return inference_data
   64 
   65     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
   66         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
   67         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   68 
   69         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
   70         tools = convert_to_tool(functions, GORILLA_TO_OPENAPI, self.model_style)
   71 
   72         inference_data["tools"] = tools
   73 
   74         return inference_data
   75 
   76     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
   77         try:
   78             model_responses = [
   79                 {func_call.function.name: func_call.function.arguments}
   80                 for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
   81             ]
   82             tool_call_ids = [
   83                 func_call.id for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
   84             ]
   85             tool_call_func_names = [
   86                 func_call.function.name
   87                 for func_call in api_response.choices[0].message.tool_calls
   88             ]
   89         except:
   90             model_responses = api_response.choices[0].message.content
   91             tool_call_ids = []
   92             tool_call_func_names = []
   93 
   94         model_responses_message_for_chat_history = api_response.choices[0].message
   95 
   96         return {
   97             "model_responses": model_responses,
   98             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": model_responses_message_for_chat_history,
   99             "tool_call_ids": tool_call_ids,
  100             "tool_call_func_names": tool_call_func_names,
  101             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
  102             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
  103         }
  104 
  105     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  106         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  107     ) -> dict:
  108         inference_data["message"].extend(first_turn_message)
  109         return inference_data
  110 
  111     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  112         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  113     ) -> dict:
  114         inference_data["message"].extend(user_message)
  115         return inference_data
  116 
  117     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  118         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  119     ) -> dict:
  120         inference_data["message"].append(
  121             model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"]
  122         )
  123         return inference_data
  124 
  125     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  126         self,
  127         inference_data: dict,
  128         execution_results: list[str],
  129         model_response_data: dict,
  130     ) -> dict:
  131         # Add the execution results to the current round result, one at a time
  132         for execution_result, tool_call_id, tool_call_func_name in zip(
  133             execution_results,
  134             model_response_data["tool_call_ids"],
  135             model_response_data["tool_call_func_names"],
  136         ):
  137             tool_message = {
  138                 "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
  139                 "role": "tool",
  140                 "name": tool_call_func_name,
  141                 "content": execution_result,
  142             }
  143             inference_data["message"].append(tool_message)
  144 
  145         return inference_data

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/base_handler.py
    1 import json
    2 import time
    3 from copy import deepcopy
    4 
    5 from bfcl_eval.constants.category_mapping import VERSION_PREFIX
    6 from bfcl_eval.constants.default_prompts import (
    7     DEFAULT_USER_PROMPT_FOR_ADDITIONAL_FUNCTION_FC,
    8     DEFAULT_USER_PROMPT_FOR_ADDITIONAL_FUNCTION_PROMPTING,
    9     MAXIMUM_STEP_LIMIT,
   10 )
   11 from bfcl_eval.constants.eval_config import RESULT_PATH
   12 from bfcl_eval.eval_checker.multi_turn_eval.multi_turn_utils import (
   13     STATELESS_CLASSES,
   14     execute_multi_turn_func_call,
   15     is_empty_execute_response,
   16 )
   17 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.model_style import ModelStyle
   18 from bfcl_eval.utils import load_file, make_json_serializable, sort_key
   19 from overrides import final
   20 
   21 
   22 class BaseHandler:
   23     model_name: str
   24     model_style: ModelStyle
   25 
   26     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   27         self.model_name = model_name
   28         # Replace the slash with underscore to avoid creating subdirectories
   29         # Replace the dash and dot with underscore for valid variable name
   30         self.model_name_underline_replaced = (
   31             model_name.replace("/", "_").replace("-", "_").replace(".", "_")
   32         )
   33         self.temperature = temperature
   34         self.is_fc_model = False  # Whether the model is a function calling model
   35 
   36     def inference(self, test_entry: dict, include_input_log: bool, exclude_state_log: bool):
   37         # This method is used to retrive model response for each model.
   38 
   39         # FC model
   40         # TODO: Let all models have the is_fc_model attribute and remove the "FC" check
   41         if "FC" in self.model_name or self.is_fc_model:
   42             if "multi_turn" in test_entry["id"]:
   43                 return self.inference_multi_turn_FC(
   44                     test_entry, include_input_log, exclude_state_log
   45                 )
   46             else:
   47                 return self.inference_single_turn_FC(test_entry, include_input_log)
   48         # Prompting model
   49         else:
   50             if "multi_turn" in test_entry["id"]:
   51                 return self.inference_multi_turn_prompting(
   52                     test_entry, include_input_log, exclude_state_log
   53                 )
   54             else:
   55                 return self.inference_single_turn_prompting(test_entry, include_input_log)
   56 
   57     @final
   58     def inference_multi_turn_FC(
   59         self, test_entry: dict, include_input_log: bool, exclude_state_log: bool
   60     ) -> tuple[list[list], dict]:
   61         initial_config: dict = test_entry["initial_config"]
   62         involved_classes: list = test_entry["involved_classes"]
   63         test_entry_id: str = test_entry["id"]
   64         test_category: str = test_entry_id.rsplit("_", 1)[0]
   65 
   66         # This is only for the miss function category
   67         # A mapping from turn index to function to holdout
   68         holdout_function: dict[int, list] = test_entry.get("missed_function", {})
   69 
   70         total_input_token_count: list[list[float]] = []
   71         total_output_token_count: list[list[float]] = []
   72         total_latency: list[list[float]] = []
   73         all_model_response: list[list] = (
   74             []
   75         )  # The model response that will be used for later evaluation
   76         all_inference_log: list[list[dict]] = (
   77             []
   78         )  # The debugging log for human to understand
   79         force_quit = False  # Whether the model has been forced to quit. If True, this whole entry will be failed.
   80 
   81         all_reasoning_content: list[list] = []
   82         # Execute no function call, but just to get a reference to all the instances to get the initial state for logging purpose
   83         if not exclude_state_log:
   84             _, involved_instances = execute_multi_turn_func_call(
   85                 [],
   86                 initial_config,
   87                 involved_classes,
   88                 self.model_name_underline_replaced,
   89                 test_entry_id,
   90                 long_context=(
   91                     "long_context" in test_category or "composite" in test_category
   92                 ),
   93                 is_evaL_run=False,
   94             )
   95             state_log = []
   96             for class_name, class_instance in involved_instances.items():
   97                 if class_name in STATELESS_CLASSES:
   98                     continue
   99                 # Avoid modification in future turns
  100                 class_instance = deepcopy(class_instance)
  101                 state_log.append(
  102                     {
  103                         "role": "state_info",
  104                         "class_name": class_name,
  105                         "content": {
  106                             key: value
  107                             for key, value in vars(class_instance).items()
  108                             if not key.startswith("_")
  109                         },
  110                     }
  111                 )
  112             all_inference_log.append(state_log)
  113 
  114         inference_data: dict = {}
  115         inference_data = self._pre_query_processing_FC(inference_data, test_entry)
  116         inference_data = self._compile_tools(inference_data, test_entry)
  117 
  118         all_multi_turn_messages: list[list[dict]] = test_entry["question"]
  119         for turn_idx, current_turn_message in enumerate(all_multi_turn_messages):
  120             current_turn_message: list[dict]
  121 
  122             if str(turn_idx) in holdout_function:
  123                 test_entry["function"].extend(holdout_function[str(turn_idx)])
  124                 # Since we have added new functions, we need to recompile the tools
  125                 inference_data = self._compile_tools(inference_data, test_entry)
  126                 assert (
  127                     len(current_turn_message) == 0
  128                 ), "Holdout turn should not have user message."
  129                 current_turn_message = [
  130                     {
  131                         "role": "user",
  132                         "content": DEFAULT_USER_PROMPT_FOR_ADDITIONAL_FUNCTION_FC,
  133                     }
  134                 ]
  135 
  136             if turn_idx == 0:
  137                 inference_data = self.add_first_turn_message_FC(
  138                     inference_data, current_turn_message
  139                 )
  140             else:
  141                 inference_data = self._add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  142                     inference_data, current_turn_message
  143                 )
  144 
  145             current_turn_response = []
  146             current_turn_inference_log: list[dict] = {
  147                 "begin_of_turn_query": current_turn_message
  148             }
  149             current_turn_input_token_count: list[float] = []
  150             current_turn_output_token_count: list[float] = []
  151             current_turn_latency: list[float] = []
  152             current_turn_reasoning_content = []
  153 
  154             count = 0
  155             while True:
  156                 print("-" * 100)
  157                 print(
  158                     f"ID: {test_entry_id.replace('multi_turn_', '')}, Turn: {turn_idx}, Step: {count}"
  159                 )
  160                 current_step_inference_log: list[dict] = []
  161                 # Add to the current_turn_inference_log at beginning of each step so that we don't need to bother dealing with the break statements
  162                 current_turn_inference_log[f"step_{count}"] = current_step_inference_log
  163 
  164                 api_response, query_latency = self._query_FC(inference_data)
  165 
  166                 # This part of logging is disabled by default because it is too verbose and will make the result file extremely large
  167                 # It is only useful to see if the inference pipeline is working as expected (eg, does it convert all the inputs correctly)
  168                 if include_input_log:
  169                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  170                         {
  171                             "role": "inference_input",
  172                             "content": inference_data.get("inference_input_log", ""),
  173                         }
  174                     )
  175 
  176                 # Try parsing the model response
  177                 model_response_data = self._parse_query_response_FC(api_response)
  178                 model_responses = model_response_data["model_responses"]
  179 
  180                 # Add the assistant message to the chat history
  181                 inference_data = self._add_assistant_message_FC(
  182                     inference_data, model_response_data
  183                 )
  184 
  185                 # Process the metadata
  186                 current_turn_input_token_count.append(model_response_data["input_token"])
  187                 current_turn_output_token_count.append(model_response_data["output_token"])
  188                 current_turn_latency.append(query_latency)
  189 
  190                 current_turn_response.append(model_responses)
  191 
  192                 reasoning_content = model_response_data.get("reasoning_content", "")
  193                 current_turn_reasoning_content.append(reasoning_content)
  194 
  195                 log_entry = {
  196                     "role": "assistant",
  197                     "content": model_responses,
  198                 }
  199                 if reasoning_content:
  200                     log_entry["reasoning_content"] = reasoning_content
  201 
  202                 current_step_inference_log.append(log_entry)
  203 
  204                 # Try decoding the model response
  205                 try:
  206                     decoded_model_responses = self.decode_execute(model_responses)
  207                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  208                         {
  209                             "role": "handler_log",
  210                             "content": "Successfully decoded model response.",
  211                             "model_response_decoded": decoded_model_responses,
  212                         }
  213                     )
  214 
  215                     if is_empty_execute_response(decoded_model_responses):
  216                         print("Empty response from the model. Proceed to next turn.")
  217                         current_step_inference_log.append(
  218                             {
  219                                 "role": "handler_log",
  220                                 "content": f"Empty response from the model. Proceed to next turn.",
  221                                 "model_response_decoded": decoded_model_responses,
  222                             }
  223                         )
  224                         break
  225 
  226                 except Exception as e:
  227                     print("Failed to decode the model response. Proceed to next turn.")
  228                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  229                         {
  230                             "role": "handler_log",
  231                             "content": f"Error decoding the model response. Proceed to next turn.",
  232                             "error": str(e),
  233                         }
  234                     )
  235                     break
  236 
  237                 # Obtain the execution results
  238                 execution_results, involved_instances = execute_multi_turn_func_call(
  239                     decoded_model_responses,
  240                     initial_config,
  241                     involved_classes,
  242                     self.model_name_underline_replaced,
  243                     test_entry_id,
  244                     long_context=(
  245                         "long_context" in test_category or "composite" in test_category
  246                     ),
  247                     is_evaL_run=False,
  248                 )
  249 
  250                 # Add the execution results to the chat history for the next turn
  251                 inference_data = self._add_execution_results_FC(
  252                     inference_data, execution_results, model_response_data
  253                 )
  254 
  255                 for execution_result in execution_results:
  256                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  257                         {
  258                             "role": "tool",
  259                             "content": execution_result,
  260                         }
  261                     )
  262 
  263                 count += 1
  264                 # Force quit after too many steps
  265                 if count > MAXIMUM_STEP_LIMIT:
  266                     force_quit = True
  267                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  268                         {
  269                             "role": "handler_log",
  270                             "content": f"Model has been forced to quit after {MAXIMUM_STEP_LIMIT} steps.",
  271                         }
  272                     )
  273 
  274                     break
  275 
  276             # Add to the total list
  277             all_model_response.append(current_turn_response)
  278             all_inference_log.append(current_turn_inference_log)
  279             all_reasoning_content.append(current_turn_reasoning_content)
  280             total_input_token_count.append(current_turn_input_token_count)
  281             total_output_token_count.append(current_turn_output_token_count)
  282             total_latency.append(current_turn_latency)
  283 
  284             if not exclude_state_log:
  285                 state_log = []
  286                 for class_name, class_instance in involved_instances.items():
  287                     if class_name in STATELESS_CLASSES:
  288                         continue
  289                     # Avoid modification in future turns
  290                     class_instance = deepcopy(class_instance)
  291                     state_log.append(
  292                         {
  293                             "role": "state_info",
  294                             "class_name": class_name,
  295                             "content": {
  296                                 key: value
  297                                 for key, value in vars(class_instance).items()
  298                                 if not key.startswith("_")
  299                             },
  300                         }
  301                     )
  302                 all_inference_log.append(state_log)
  303 
  304             if force_quit:
  305                 break
  306 
  307         metadata = {
  308             "input_token_count": total_input_token_count,
  309             "output_token_count": total_output_token_count,
  310             "latency": total_latency,
  311             "inference_log": all_inference_log,
  312         }
  313 
  314         if not all(
  315             all(content == "" for content in single_turn_reasoning_content)
  316             for single_turn_reasoning_content in all_reasoning_content
  317         ):
  318             metadata["reasoning_content"] = all_reasoning_content
  319 
  320         return all_model_response, metadata
  321 
  322     @final
  323     def inference_multi_turn_prompting(
  324         self, test_entry: dict, include_input_log: bool, exclude_state_log: bool
  325     ) -> tuple[list[list], dict]:
  326         initial_config: dict = test_entry["initial_config"]
  327         involved_classes: list = test_entry["involved_classes"]
  328         test_entry_id: str = test_entry["id"]
  329         test_category: str = test_entry_id.rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  330 
  331         # This is only for the miss function category
  332         # A mapping from turn index to function to holdout
  333         holdout_function: dict[int, list] = test_entry.get("missed_function", {})
  334 
  335         total_input_token_count: list[list[float]] = []
  336         total_output_token_count: list[list[float]] = []
  337         total_latency: list[list[float]] = []
  338         # The model response that will be used for later evaluation
  339         all_model_response: list[list] = []
  340         # Only for reasoning models, reasoning content will be stored as part of metadata and in inference log
  341         all_reasoning_content: list[list] = []
  342         # The debugging log for human to understand
  343         all_inference_log: list[list[dict]] = []
  344         force_quit = False  # Whether the model has been forced to quit. If True, this whole entry will be failed.
  345 
  346         # Execute no function call, but just to get a reference to all the instances to get the initial state for logging purpose
  347         if not exclude_state_log:
  348             _, involved_instances = execute_multi_turn_func_call(
  349                 [],
  350                 initial_config,
  351                 involved_classes,
  352                 self.model_name_underline_replaced,
  353                 test_entry_id,
  354                 long_context=(
  355                     "long_context" in test_category or "composite" in test_category
  356                 ),
  357                 is_evaL_run=False,
  358             )
  359             state_log = []
  360             for class_name, class_instance in involved_instances.items():
  361                 if class_name in STATELESS_CLASSES:
  362                     continue
  363                 # Avoid modification in future turns
  364                 class_instance = deepcopy(class_instance)
  365                 state_log.append(
  366                     {
  367                         "role": "state_info",
  368                         "class_name": class_name,
  369                         "content": {
  370                             key: value
  371                             for key, value in vars(class_instance).items()
  372                             if not key.startswith("_")
  373                         },
  374                     }
  375                 )
  376             all_inference_log.append(state_log)
  377 
  378         inference_data: dict = self._pre_query_processing_prompting(test_entry)
  379 
  380         all_multi_turn_messages: list[list[dict]] = test_entry["question"]
  381         for turn_idx, current_turn_message in enumerate(all_multi_turn_messages):
  382             current_turn_message: list[dict]
  383 
  384             if str(turn_idx) in holdout_function:
  385                 assert (
  386                     len(current_turn_message) == 0
  387                 ), "Holdout turn should not have user message."
  388                 current_turn_message = [
  389                     {
  390                         "role": "user",
  391                         "content": DEFAULT_USER_PROMPT_FOR_ADDITIONAL_FUNCTION_PROMPTING.format(
  392                             functions=holdout_function[str(turn_idx)]
  393                         ),
  394                     }
  395                 ]
  396 
  397             if turn_idx == 0:
  398                 inference_data = self.add_first_turn_message_prompting(
  399                     inference_data, current_turn_message
  400                 )
  401             else:
  402                 inference_data = self._add_next_turn_user_message_prompting(
  403                     inference_data, current_turn_message
  404                 )
  405 
  406             current_turn_response = []
  407             current_turn_reasoning_content = []
  408             current_turn_inference_log: list[dict] = {
  409                 "begin_of_turn_query": current_turn_message
  410             }
  411             current_turn_input_token_count: list[float] = []
  412             current_turn_output_token_count: list[float] = []
  413             current_turn_latency: list[float] = []
  414 
  415             count = 0
  416             while True:
  417                 print("-" * 100)
  418                 print(
  419                     f"ID: {test_entry_id.replace('multi_turn_', '')}, Turn: {turn_idx}, Step: {count}"
  420                 )
  421                 current_step_inference_log: list[dict] = []
  422                 # Add to the current_turn_inference_log at beginning of each step so that we don't need to bother dealing with the break statements
  423                 current_turn_inference_log[f"step_{count}"] = current_step_inference_log
  424 
  425                 api_response, query_latency = self._query_prompting(inference_data)
  426 
  427                 # This part of logging is disabled by default because it is too verbose and will make the result file extremely large
  428                 # It is only useful to see if the inference pipeline is working as expected (eg, does it convert all the inputs correctly)
  429                 if include_input_log:
  430                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  431                         {
  432                             "role": "inference_input",
  433                             "content": inference_data.get("inference_input_log", ""),
  434                         }
  435                     )
  436 
  437                 # Try parsing the model response
  438                 model_response_data = self._parse_query_response_prompting(api_response)
  439                 model_responses = model_response_data["model_responses"]
  440 
  441                 # Add the assistant message to the chat history
  442                 inference_data = self._add_assistant_message_prompting(
  443                     inference_data, model_response_data
  444                 )
  445 
  446                 # Process the metadata
  447                 current_turn_input_token_count.append(model_response_data["input_token"])
  448                 current_turn_output_token_count.append(model_response_data["output_token"])
  449                 current_turn_latency.append(query_latency)
  450 
  451                 current_turn_response.append(model_responses)
  452                 reasoning_content = model_response_data.get("reasoning_content", "")
  453                 current_turn_reasoning_content.append(reasoning_content)
  454 
  455                 log_entry = {
  456                     "role": "assistant",
  457                     "content": model_responses,
  458                 }
  459                 if reasoning_content:
  460                     log_entry["reasoning_content"] = reasoning_content
  461 
  462                 current_step_inference_log.append(log_entry)
  463 
  464                 # Try decoding the model response
  465                 try:
  466                     decoded_model_responses = self.decode_execute(model_responses)
  467                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  468                         {
  469                             "role": "handler_log",
  470                             "content": "Successfully decoded model response.",
  471                             "model_response_decoded": decoded_model_responses,
  472                         }
  473                     )
  474 
  475                     model_response_data["model_responses_decoded"] = decoded_model_responses
  476                     if is_empty_execute_response(decoded_model_responses):
  477                         print("Empty response from the model. Proceed to next turn.")
  478                         current_step_inference_log.append(
  479                             {
  480                                 "role": "handler_log",
  481                                 "content": f"Empty response from the model. Proceed to next turn.",
  482                                 "model_response_decoded": decoded_model_responses,
  483                             }
  484                         )
  485                         break
  486 
  487                 except Exception as e:
  488                     print("Failed to decode the model response. Proceed to next turn.")
  489                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  490                         {
  491                             "role": "handler_log",
  492                             "content": f"Error decoding the model response. Proceed to next turn.",
  493                             "error": str(e),
  494                         }
  495                     )
  496                     break
  497 
  498                 # Obtain the execution results
  499                 execution_results, involved_instances = execute_multi_turn_func_call(
  500                     decoded_model_responses,
  501                     initial_config,
  502                     involved_classes,
  503                     self.model_name_underline_replaced,
  504                     test_entry_id,
  505                     long_context=(
  506                         "long_context" in test_category or "composite" in test_category
  507                     ),
  508                     is_evaL_run=False,
  509                 )
  510 
  511                 # Add the execution results to the chat history for the next turn
  512                 inference_data = self._add_execution_results_prompting(
  513                     inference_data, execution_results, model_response_data
  514                 )
  515 
  516                 for execution_result in execution_results:
  517                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  518                         {
  519                             "role": "tool",
  520                             "content": execution_result,
  521                         }
  522                     )
  523 
  524                 count += 1
  525                 # Force quit after too many steps
  526                 if count > MAXIMUM_STEP_LIMIT:
  527                     force_quit = True
  528                     current_step_inference_log.append(
  529                         {
  530                             "role": "handler_log",
  531                             "content": f"Model has been forced to quit after {MAXIMUM_STEP_LIMIT} steps.",
  532                         }
  533                     )
  534                     break
  535 
  536             # Add to the total list
  537             all_model_response.append(current_turn_response)
  538             all_reasoning_content.append(current_turn_reasoning_content)
  539             all_inference_log.append(current_turn_inference_log)
  540             total_input_token_count.append(current_turn_input_token_count)
  541             total_output_token_count.append(current_turn_output_token_count)
  542             total_latency.append(current_turn_latency)
  543 
  544             if not exclude_state_log:
  545                 state_log = []
  546                 for class_name, class_instance in involved_instances.items():
  547                     if class_name in STATELESS_CLASSES:
  548                         continue
  549                     # Avoid modification in future turns
  550                     class_instance = deepcopy(class_instance)
  551                     state_log.append(
  552                         {
  553                             "role": "state_info",
  554                             "class_name": class_name,
  555                             "content": {
  556                                 key: value
  557                                 for key, value in vars(class_instance).items()
  558                                 if not key.startswith("_")
  559                             },
  560                         }
  561                     )
  562                 all_inference_log.append(state_log)
  563 
  564             if force_quit:
  565                 break
  566 
  567         metadata = {
  568             "input_token_count": total_input_token_count,
  569             "output_token_count": total_output_token_count,
  570             "latency": total_latency,
  571             "inference_log": all_inference_log,
  572         }
  573         # We only include reasoning content if it exists and is not empty
  574         if not all(
  575             all(content == "" for content in single_turn_reasoning_content)
  576             for single_turn_reasoning_content in all_reasoning_content
  577         ):
  578             metadata["reasoning_content"] = all_reasoning_content
  579 
  580         return all_model_response, metadata
  581 
  582     @final
  583     def inference_single_turn_FC(
  584         self, test_entry: dict, include_input_log: bool
  585     ) -> tuple[any, dict]:
  586         inference_data: dict = {}
  587         inference_data = self._pre_query_processing_FC(inference_data, test_entry)
  588         inference_data = self._compile_tools(inference_data, test_entry)
  589         inference_data = self.add_first_turn_message_FC(
  590             inference_data, test_entry["question"][0]
  591         )
  592 
  593         api_response, query_latency = self._query_FC(inference_data)
  594 
  595         # Try parsing the model response
  596         model_response_data = self._parse_query_response_FC(api_response)
  597 
  598         # Process the metadata
  599         metadata = {}
  600         if include_input_log:
  601             metadata["inference_log"] = [
  602                 {
  603                     "role": "inference_input",
  604                     "content": inference_data.get("inference_input_log", ""),
  605                 }
  606             ]
  607         metadata["input_token_count"] = model_response_data["input_token"]
  608         metadata["output_token_count"] = model_response_data["output_token"]
  609         metadata["latency"] = query_latency
  610 
  611         if (
  612             "reasoning_content" in model_response_data
  613             and model_response_data["reasoning_content"] != ""
  614         ):
  615             metadata["reasoning_content"] = model_response_data["reasoning_content"]
  616 
  617         return model_response_data["model_responses"], metadata
  618 
  619     @final
  620     def inference_single_turn_prompting(
  621         self, test_entry: dict, include_input_log: bool
  622     ) -> tuple[any, dict]:
  623         inference_data: dict = self._pre_query_processing_prompting(test_entry)
  624         inference_data = self.add_first_turn_message_prompting(
  625             inference_data, test_entry["question"][0]
  626         )
  627 
  628         api_response, query_latency = self._query_prompting(inference_data)
  629 
  630         # Try parsing the model response
  631         model_response_data = self._parse_query_response_prompting(api_response)
  632 
  633         # Process the metadata
  634         metadata = {}
  635         if include_input_log:
  636             metadata["inference_log"] = [
  637                 {
  638                     "role": "inference_input",
  639                     "content": inference_data.get("inference_input_log", ""),
  640                 }
  641             ]
  642         metadata["input_token_count"] = model_response_data["input_token"]
  643         metadata["output_token_count"] = model_response_data["output_token"]
  644         metadata["latency"] = query_latency
  645 
  646         if (
  647             "reasoning_content" in model_response_data
  648             and model_response_data["reasoning_content"] != ""
  649         ):
  650             metadata["reasoning_content"] = model_response_data["reasoning_content"]
  651 
  652         return model_response_data["model_responses"], metadata
  653 
  654     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
  655         """
  656         This method takes raw model output (from `_parse_query_response_xxx`) and convert it to standard AST checker input.
  657         """
  658         raise NotImplementedError
  659 
  660     def decode_execute(self, result):
  661         """
  662         This method takes raw model output (from `_parse_query_response_xxx`) and convert it to standard execute checker input.
  663         """
  664         raise NotImplementedError
  665 
  666     @final
  667     def write(self, result, result_dir, update_mode=False):
  668         model_name_dir = self.model_name.replace("/", "_")
  669         model_result_dir = result_dir / model_name_dir
  670         model_result_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  671 
  672         if isinstance(result, dict):
  673             result = [result]
  674 
  675         # Collect and format each entry for JSON compatibility
  676         entries_to_write = [make_json_serializable(entry) for entry in result]
  677 
  678         # Group entries by their `test_category` for efficient file handling
  679         file_entries = {}
  680         for entry in entries_to_write:
  681             test_category = entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  682             file_name = f"{VERSION_PREFIX}_{test_category}_result.json"
  683             file_path = model_result_dir / file_name
  684             file_entries.setdefault(file_path, []).append(entry)
  685 
  686         for file_path, entries in file_entries.items():
  687             if update_mode:
  688                 # Load existing entries from the file
  689                 existing_entries = {}
  690                 if file_path.exists():
  691                     existing_entries = {
  692                         entry["id"]: entry for entry in load_file(file_path)
  693                     }
  694 
  695                 # Update existing entries with new data
  696                 for entry in entries:
  697                     existing_entries[entry["id"]] = entry
  698 
  699                 # Sort entries by `id` and write them back to ensure order consistency
  700                 sorted_entries = sorted(existing_entries.values(), key=sort_key)
  701                 with open(file_path, "w") as f:
  702                     for entry in sorted_entries:
  703                         f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
  704 
  705             else:
  706                 # Normal mode: Append in sorted order
  707                 entries.sort(key=sort_key)
  708                 with open(file_path, "a") as f:
  709                     for entry in entries:
  710                         f.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")
  711 
  712     #### FC methods ####
  713 
  714     def _query_FC(self, inference_data: dict):
  715         """
  716         Call the model API in FC mode to get the response.
  717         Return the response object that can be used to feed into the `_parse_query_response_FC` method.
  718         """
  719         raise NotImplementedError
  720 
  721     def _pre_query_processing_FC(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  722         """
  723         Preprocess the testset entry before sending it to the model.
  724         This might includes transforming the input user message into the format expected by the model, extract out the system prompt (if any), and any other necessary preprocessing steps. Those steps can also be done in the `add_first_turn_message_FC` and `_add_next_turn_user_message_FC` methods, but it's usually cleaner to do it here.
  725         The inference_data dict is updated in place and returned.
  726 
  727         Note: This method has different signature from its Prompting version.
  728         """
  729         raise NotImplementedError
  730 
  731     def _compile_tools(self, inference_data: dict, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  732         """
  733         [Only for FC mode]
  734         This method is used to prepare/compile the tools from the test entry and add them to the inference data to use for model query in FC mode.
  735         Function docs usually need to be transformed to the format expected by the model, done through the `convert_to_tool` function from `model_handler/utils.py`.
  736         The inference_data dict is updated in place and returned.
  737         """
  738         raise NotImplementedError
  739 
  740     def _parse_query_response_FC(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  741         """
  742         Parses the raw response from the model API to extract the result, input token count, and output token count.
  743 
  744         Args:
  745             api_response (any): The raw response from the model API.
  746 
  747         Returns:
  748             A dict containing the following elements:
  749                 - model_responses (any): The parsed result that can be directly used as input to the decode method.
  750                 - input_token (int): The number of tokens used in the input to the model.
  751                 - output_token (int): The number of tokens generated by the model as output.
  752                 - tool_call_ids (list[str]): The IDs of the tool calls that are generated by the model. Optional.
  753                 - Any other metadata that is specific to the model.
  754         """
  755         raise NotImplementedError
  756 
  757     def add_first_turn_message_FC(
  758         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  759     ) -> dict:
  760         """
  761         Add the first turn message to the chat history, in the format that the model expects.
  762 
  763         Args:
  764             inference_data (dict): The inference data from previous processing steps.
  765             first_turn_message (list[dict]): The first turn message from the test entry. It has variable length. It might contain one or more of the following roles:
  766                 - "system": The system message. This role will only appear at most once, at the beginning of the first turn. For most entry, this role will not appear.
  767                 - "user": The user message.
  768                 - "assistant": The assistant message. For most entry, this role will not appear.
  769 
  770         Returns:
  771             inference_data (dict): The updated inference data that will be send to `_query_FC` to call the model API.
  772         """
  773         raise NotImplementedError
  774 
  775     def _add_next_turn_user_message_FC(
  776         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  777     ) -> dict:
  778         """
  779         [Only for multi-turn]
  780         Add next turn user message to the chat history for query.
  781         user_message is a list of 1 element, which is guaranteed to be a `user` role message.
  782         """
  783         raise NotImplementedError
  784 
  785     def _add_assistant_message_FC(
  786         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  787     ) -> dict:
  788         """
  789         Add assistant message to the chat history.
  790         """
  791         raise NotImplementedError
  792 
  793     def _add_execution_results_FC(
  794         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  795     ) -> dict:
  796         """
  797         Add the execution results to the chat history to prepare for the next turn of query.
  798         Some models may need to add additional information to the chat history, such as tool call IDs.
  799         """
  800         raise NotImplementedError
  801 
  802     #### Prompting methods ####
  803 
  804     def _query_prompting(self, inference_data: dict):
  805         """
  806         Call the model API in prompting mode to get the response.
  807         Return the response object that can be used to feed into the decode method.
  808         """
  809         raise NotImplementedError
  810 
  811     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  812         """
  813         Preprocess the testset entry before sending it to the model.
  814         This might includes transforming the input user message into the format expected by the model, extract out the system prompt (if any), and any other necessary preprocessing steps. Those steps can also be done in the `add_first_turn_message_prompting` and `_add_next_turn_user_message_prompting` methods, but it's usually cleaner to do it here.
  815         The function docs are usually supplied to the prompting models as part of the system prompt, done via the `system_prompt_pre_processing_chat_model` function from `model_handler/utils.py`, unless the model has a different way of handling it.
  816         Returns a dict that contains all the necessary information for the query method.
  817         Things like `system_prompt` and `chat_history` are optional, specific to the model.
  818 
  819         Note: This method has different signature from its FC version.
  820         """
  821         raise NotImplementedError
  822 
  823     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  824         """
  825         Parses the raw response from the model API to extract the result, input token count, and output token count.
  826 
  827         Args:
  828             api_response (any): The raw response from the model API.
  829 
  830         Returns:
  831             A dict containing the following elements:
  832                 - model_responses (any): The parsed result that can be directly used as input to the decode method.
  833                 - input_token (int): The number of tokens used in the input to the model.
  834                 - output_token (int): The number of tokens generated by the model as output.
  835                 - Any other metadata that is specific to the model.
  836         """
  837         raise NotImplementedError
  838 
  839     def add_first_turn_message_prompting(
  840         self, inference_data: dict, first_turn_message: list[dict]
  841     ) -> dict:
  842         """
  843         Add the first turn message to the chat history, in the format that the model expects.
  844 
  845         Args:
  846             inference_data (dict): The inference data from previous processing steps.
  847             first_turn_message (list[dict]): The first turn message from the test entry. It has variable length. It might contain one or more of the following roles:
  848                 - "system": The system message. This role will only appear at most once, at the beginning of the first turn.
  849                 - "user": The user message.
  850                 - "assistant": The assistant message. For most entry, this role will not appear.
  851 
  852         Returns:
  853             inference_data (dict): The updated inference data that will be send to `_query_prompting` to call the model API.
  854         """
  855         raise NotImplementedError
  856 
  857     def _add_next_turn_user_message_prompting(
  858         self, inference_data: dict, user_message: list[dict]
  859     ) -> dict:
  860         """
  861         [Only for multi-turn]
  862         Add next turn user message to the chat history for query.
  863         user_message is a list of 1 element, which is guaranteed to be a `user` role message.
  864         """
  865         raise NotImplementedError
  866 
  867     def _add_assistant_message_prompting(
  868         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  869     ) -> dict:
  870         """
  871         Add assistant message to the chat history.
  872         """
  873         raise NotImplementedError
  874 
  875     def _add_execution_results_prompting(
  876         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  877     ) -> dict:
  878         """
  879         Add the execution results to the chat history to prepare for the next turn of query.
  880         By default, execution results are added back as a `user` role message, as most models don't support the `tool` role in prompting mode.
  881         """
  882         raise NotImplementedError
