   13 class MistralFCHandler(OSSHandler):
   14     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   15         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   16 
   17     @override
   18     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   19         # The input is already a list of dictionaries, so no need to decode
   20         # `[{func1:{param1:val1,...}},{func2:{param2:val2,...}}]`
   21         if type(result) != list:
   22             return []
   23         return result
   24 
   25     @override
   26     def decode_execute(self, result):
   27         if type(result) != list:
   28             return []
   29         return convert_to_function_call(result)
   30 
   31     @staticmethod
   32     def _construct_func_doc(functions):
   33         """
   34         {{- "[AVAILABLE_TOOLS][" }}
   35         {%- for tool in tools %}
   36             {%- set tool = tool.function %}
   37             {{- '{"type": "function", "function": {' }}
   38             {%- for key, val in tool.items() if key != "return" %}
   39                 {%- if val is string %}
   40                     {{- '"' + key + '": "' + val + '"' }}
   41                 {%- else %}
   42                     {{- '"' + key + '": ' + val|tojson }}
   43                 {%- endif %}
   44                 {%- if not loop.last %}
   45                     {{- ", " }}
   46                 {%- endif %}
   47             {%- endfor %}
   48             {{- "}}" }}
   49             {%- if not loop.last %}
   50                 {{- ", " }}
   51             {%- else %}
   52                 {{- "]" }}
   53             {%- endif %}
   54         {%- endfor %}
   55         {{- "[/AVAILABLE_TOOLS]" }}
   56         """
   57         func_docs = []
   58         for tool in functions:
   59             func_doc = '{"type": "function", "function": {'
   60             func_doc += ", ".join(
   61                 (
   62                     f'"{key}": "{val}"'
   63                     if isinstance(val, str)
   64                     else f'"{key}": {json.dumps(val)}'
   65                 )
   66                 for key, val in tool.items()
   67                 if key != "return"
   68             )
   69             func_doc += "}}"
   70             func_docs.append(func_doc)
   71 
   72         result_str = "[AVAILABLE_TOOLS][" + ", ".join(func_docs) + "][/AVAILABLE_TOOLS]"
   73         return result_str
   74 
   75     @override
   76     def _format_prompt(self, messages, function):
   77         """
   78         "bos_token": "<s>"
   79         "eos_token": "</s>"
   80         "chat_template":
   81         {%- if messages[0]["role"] == "system" %}
   82             {%- set system_message = messages[0]["content"] %}
   83             {%- set loop_messages = messages[1:] %}
   84         {%- else %}
   85             {%- set loop_messages = messages %}
   86         {%- endif %}
   87         {%- if not tools is defined %}
   88             {%- set tools = none %}
   89         {%- endif %}
   90         {%- set user_messages = loop_messages | selectattr("role", "equalto", "user") | list %}
   91 
   92         {#- This block checks for alternating user/assistant messages, skipping tool calling messages #}
   93         {%- set ns = namespace() %}
   94         {%- set ns.index = 0 %}
   95         {%- for message in loop_messages %}
   96             {%- if not (message.role == "tool" or message.role == "tool_results" or (message.tool_calls is defined and message.tool_calls is not none)) %}
   97                 {%- if (message["role"] == "user") != (ns.index % 2 == 0) %}
   98                     {{- raise_exception("After the optional system message, conversation roles must alternate user/assistant/user/assistant/...") }}
   99                 {%- endif %}
  100                 {%- set ns.index = ns.index + 1 %}
  101             {%- endif %}
  102         {%- endfor %}
  103 
  104         {{- bos_token }}
  105         {%- for message in loop_messages %}
  106             {%- if message["role"] == "user" %}
  107                 {%- if tools is not none and (message == user_messages[-1]) %}
  108                     {{- "[AVAILABLE_TOOLS][" }}
  109                     {%- for tool in tools %}
  110                         {%- set tool = tool.function %}
  111                         {{- '{"type": "function", "function": {' }}
  112                         {%- for key, val in tool.items() if key != "return" %}
  113                             {%- if val is string %}
  114                                 {{- '"' + key + '": "' + val + '"' }}
  115                             {%- else %}
  116                                 {{- '"' + key + '": ' + val|tojson }}
  117                             {%- endif %}
  118                             {%- if not loop.last %}
  119                                 {{- ", " }}
  120                             {%- endif %}
  121                         {%- endfor %}
  122                         {{- "}}" }}
  123                         {%- if not loop.last %}
  124                             {{- ", " }}
  125                         {%- else %}
  126                             {{- "]" }}
  127                         {%- endif %}
  128                     {%- endfor %}
  129                     {{- "[/AVAILABLE_TOOLS]" }}
  130                     {%- endif %}
  131                 {%- if loop.last and system_message is defined %}
  132                     {{- "[INST]" + system_message + "\n\n" + message["content"] + "[/INST]" }}
  133                 {%- else %}
  134                     {{- "[INST]" + message["content"] + "[/INST]" }}
  135                 {%- endif %}
  136             {%- elif (message.tool_calls is defined and message.tool_calls is not none) %}
  137                 {{- "[TOOL_CALLS][" }}
  138                 {%- for tool_call in message.tool_calls %}
  139                     {%- set out = tool_call.function|tojson %}
  140                     {{- out[:-1] }}
  141                     {%- if not tool_call.id is defined or tool_call.id|length != 9 %}
  142                         {{- raise_exception("Tool call IDs should be alphanumeric strings with length 9!") }}
  143                     {%- endif %}
  144                     {{- ', "id": "' + tool_call.id + '"}' }}
  145                     {%- if not loop.last %}
  146                         {{- ", " }}
  147                     {%- else %}
  148                         {{- "]" + eos_token }}
  149                     {%- endif %}
  150                 {%- endfor %}
  151             {%- elif message["role"] == "assistant" %}
  152                 {{- message["content"] + eos_token}}
  153             {%- elif message["role"] == "tool_results" or message["role"] == "tool" %}
  154                 {%- if message.content is defined and message.content.content is defined %}
  155                     {%- set content = message.content.content %}
  156                 {%- else %}
  157                     {%- set content = message.content %}
  158                 {%- endif %}
  159                 {{- '[TOOL_RESULTS]{"content": ' + content|string + ", " }}
  160                 {%- if not message.tool_call_id is defined or message.tool_call_id|length != 9 %}
  161                     {{- raise_exception("Tool call IDs should be alphanumeric strings with length 9!") }}
  162                 {%- endif %}
  163                 {{- '"call_id": "' + message.tool_call_id + '"}[/TOOL_RESULTS]' }}
  164             {%- else %}
  165                 {{- raise_exception("Only user and assistant roles are supported, with the exception of an initial optional system message!") }}
  166             {%- endif %}
  167         {%- endfor %}
  168         """
  169         bos_token = "<s>"
  170         eos_token = "</s>"
  171 
  172         formatted_prompt = bos_token
  173 
  174         # Handle optional system message
  175         first_message = messages[0]
  176         if first_message["role"] == "system":
  177             system_message = first_message["content"]
  178             loop_messages = messages[1:]
  179         else:
  180             system_message = None
  181             loop_messages = messages
  182 
  183         # Extract user messages for later reference
  184         user_messages = [msg for msg in loop_messages if msg["role"] == "user"]
  185 
  186         for idx, message in enumerate(loop_messages):
  187             role = message["role"]
  188 
  189             if role == "user":
  190                 # If this is the last user message and tools are provided, append AVAILABLE_TOOLS
  191                 if len(function) > 0 and message == user_messages[-1]:
  192                     formatted_prompt += self._construct_func_doc(function)
  193 
  194                 # If it's the last message and there's a system message, include it
  195                 if idx == len(loop_messages) - 1 and system_message:
  196                     formatted_prompt += (
  197                         f"[INST]{system_message}\n\n{message['content']}[/INST]"
  198                     )
  199                 else:
  200                     formatted_prompt += f"[INST]{message['content']}[/INST]"
  201 
  202             elif role == "assistant":
  203                 # There is no need to further special handle the tool calls messages
  204                 # They are already correctly formatted in the `_parse_query_response_prompting` method, including the tool call id and the `[TOOL_CALLS]` tag
  205                 formatted_prompt += f"{message['content']}{eos_token}"
  206 
  207             elif role == "tool":
  208                 tool_results = {
  209                     "content": message["content"],
  210                     "call_id": message["tool_call_id"],
  211                 }
  212                 formatted_prompt += (
  213                     f"[TOOL_RESULTS]{json.dumps(tool_results)}[/TOOL_RESULTS]"
  214                 )
  215 
  216         formatted_prompt += eos_token
  217         return formatted_prompt
  218 
  219     @override
  220     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  221         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  222         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  223 
  224         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  225         # We don't add system prompt
  226 
  227         return {"message": [], "function": functions}
  228 
  229     @override
  230     def _add_execution_results_prompting(
  231         self, inference_data: dict, execution_results: list[str], model_response_data: dict
  232     ) -> dict:
  233         for execution_result, tool_call_id in zip(
  234             execution_results, model_response_data["tool_call_ids"]
  235         ):
  236             inference_data["message"].append(
  237                 {
  238                     "role": "tool",
  239                     "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
  240                     "content": execution_result,
  241                 }
  242             )
  243 
  244         return inference_data
  245 
  246     @staticmethod
  247     def generate_random_string() -> str:
  248         """Generates a random string of alphanumeric characters of length 9."""
  249         characters = string.ascii_letters + string.digits
  250         random_string = "".join(random.choices(characters, k=9))
  251         return random_string
  252 
  253     @override
  254     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  255         model_responses = api_response.choices[0].text
  256         tool_call_ids = []
  257         """
  258         Mistral models require a tool_call_id, which should be 9 randomly-generated alphanumeric characters, and assigned to the id key of the tool call dictionary.
  259         Source: https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/chat_templating#advanced-tool-use--function-calling
  260         
  261         "[{\"name\": \"math.factorial\", \"arguments\": {\"number\": 5}}, {\"name\": \"math.factorial\", \"arguments\": {\"number\": 10}}, {\"name\": \"math.factorial\", \"arguments\": {\"number\": 15}}]"
  262         """
  263         try:
  264             model_responses = json.loads(model_responses)
  265             for model_response in model_responses:
  266                 tool_call_id = self.generate_random_string()
  267                 model_response["id"] = tool_call_id
  268                 tool_call_ids.append(tool_call_id)
  269 
  270             # We prepare the model responses here because it's easier to do it here than in the `_format_prompt` method
  271             # The `[TOOL_CALLS]` tag is added here, as required by the chat template
  272             model_responses_message_for_chat_history = (
  273                 f"[TOOL_CALLS]{json.dumps(model_responses)}"
  274             )
  275 
  276             model_responses = [
  277                 {item["name"]: item["arguments"]} for item in model_responses
  278             ]
  279         except json.JSONDecodeError:
  280             model_responses_message_for_chat_history = model_responses
  281 
  282         return {
  283             "model_responses": model_responses,
  284             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": model_responses_message_for_chat_history,
  285             "tool_call_ids": tool_call_ids,
  286             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
  287             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
  288         }
  289 
  290     @override
  291     def _add_assistant_message_prompting(
  292         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  293     ) -> dict:
  294         inference_data["message"].append(
  295             {
  296                 "role": "assistant",
  297                 "content": model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"],
  298             }
  299         )
  300         return inference_data

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/local_inference/phi.py
    1 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.local_inference.base_oss_handler import OSSHandler

    4 
    5 class PhiHandler(OSSHandler):
    6     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
    7         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
    8 
    9     @override
   10     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   11         result = result.strip()
   12         if result.startswith("```json"):
   13             result = result[len("```json") :]
   14         if result.startswith("```python"):
   15             result = result[len("```python") :]
   16         return super().decode_ast(result, language)
   17 
   18     @override
   19     def decode_execute(self, result):
   20         if result.startswith("```json"):
   21             result = result[len("```json") :]
   22         if result.startswith("```python"):
   23             result = result[len("```python") :]
   24         return super().decode_execute(result)
   25 
   26     @override
   27     def _format_prompt(self, messages, function):
   28         formatted_prompt = ""
   29 
   30         if "Phi-4-mini" in self.model_name:
   31             # Phi-4-mini
   32             """
   33             "chat_template": "{% for message in messages %}{% if message['role'] == 'system' and 'tools' in message and message['tools'] is not none %}{{ '<|' + message['role'] + '|>' + message['content'] + '<|tool|>' + message['tools'] + '<|/tool|>' + '<|end|>' }}{% else %}{{ '<|' + message['role'] + '|>' + message['content'] + '<|end|>' }}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}{{ '<|assistant|>' }}{% else %}{{ eos_token }}{% endif %}"
   34             """
   35             for message in messages:
   36                 formatted_prompt += f"<|{message['role']}|>{message['content']}<|end|>"
   37             formatted_prompt += "<|assistant|>"
   38 
   39         else:
   40             # Phi-4
   41             """
   42             "chat_template": "{% for message in messages %}{% if (message['role'] == 'system') %}{{'<|im_start|>system<|im_sep|>' + message['content'] + '<|im_end|>'}}{% elif (message['role'] == 'user') %}{{'<|im_start|>user<|im_sep|>' + message['content'] + '<|im_end|>'}}{% elif (message['role'] == 'assistant') %}{{'<|im_start|>assistant<|im_sep|>' + message['content'] + '<|im_end|>'}}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if add_generation_prompt %}{{ '<|im_start|>assistant<|im_sep|>' }}{% endif %}"
   43             """
   44             for message in messages:
   45                 formatted_prompt += f"<|im_start|>{message['role']}<|im_sep|>{message['content']}<|im_end|>\n"
   46             formatted_prompt += "<|im_start|>assistant<|im_sep|>"
   47 
   48         return formatted_prompt

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/local_inference/phi_fc.py
    1 import json
    2 import re
    3 
    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.local_inference.base_oss_handler import OSSHandler
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    6     convert_to_function_call,
    7     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
    8 )
    9 from overrides import override
   10 
   11 
   12 class PhiFCHandler(OSSHandler):
   13     """
   14     This class implements a function-calling handler for the Microsoft Phi series of models.
   15 
   16     Specifically, this handler currently supports the following models:
   17     - microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct
   18     """
   19 
   20     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   21         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   22         self.model_name_huggingface = model_name.replace("-FC", "")
   23         self.is_fc_model = True
   24 
   25     @override
   26     def _format_prompt(self, messages, function):
   27         """
   28         "bos_token": "<|endoftext|>",
   29         "chat_template":
   30         {% for message in messages %}
   31           {% if message['role'] == 'system' and 'tools' in message and message['tools'] is not none %}
   32             {{ '<|' + message['role'] + '|>' + message['content'] + '<|tool|>' + message['tools'] + '<|/tool|>' + '<|end|>' }}
   33           {% else %}
   34             {{ '<|' + message['role'] + '|>' + message['content'] + '<|end|>' }}
   35           {% endif %}
   36         {% endfor %}
   37         {% if add_generation_prompt %}
   38           {{ '<|assistant|>' }}
   39         {% else %}
   40           {{ eos_token }}
   41         {% endif %}
   42         """
   43 
   44         # Here's Microsoft's documentation on how the Phi-4-mini-instruct model expects tools to be provided to it:
   45         # Tool-enabled function-calling format
   46         #
   47         # # Tools
   48         # This format is used when the user wants the model to provide function calls based on the given tools.
   49         # The user should provide the available tools in the system prompt, wrapped by <|tool|> and <|/tool|> tokens.
   50         # The tools should be specified in JSON format, using a JSON dump structure. Example:
   51         #
   52         # <|system|>You are a helpful assistant with some tools.<|tool|>[{"name": "get_weather_updates", "description": "Fetches weather updates for a given city using the RapidAPI Weather API.", "parameters": {"city": {"description": "The name of the city for which to retrieve weather information.", "type": "str", "default": "London"}}}]<|/tool|><|end|><|user|>What is the weather like in Paris today?<|end|><|assistant|>
   53         #
   54 
   55         # sanity check
   56         system_messages = [msg for msg in messages if msg["role"] == "system"]
   57         assert 0 <= len(system_messages) <= 1
   58 
   59         # set the system message
   60         system_message = "You are a helpful assistant with some tools."
   61         if messages[0]["role"] == "system":
   62             system_message = messages[0]["content"]
   63             messages = messages[1:]
   64 
   65         # extract the tool contents
   66         tool_contents = ""
   67         for func in function:
   68             # microsoft documentation has no guidance on indentation
   69             tool_contents += json.dumps(func)
   70             tool_contents += "\n"
   71 
   72         # format the rest of the prompt
   73         formatted_prompt = (
   74             f"<|system|>{system_message}<|tool|>{tool_contents}<|/tool|><|end|>"
   75         )
   76         for msg in messages:
   77             role = msg["role"]
   78             content = msg["content"]
   79             formatted_prompt += f"<|{role}|>{content}<|end|>"
   80 
   81         # provide the generation prompt token
   82         formatted_prompt += "<|assistant|>"
   83         return formatted_prompt
   84 
   85     @override
   86     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   87         # The input is already a list of dictionaries, so no need to decode
   88         # `[{func1:{param1:val1,...}},{func2:{param2:val2,...}}]`
   89         if type(result) != list or any(type(item) != dict for item in result):
   90             return []
   91         return result
   92 
   93     @override
   94     def decode_execute(self, result):
   95         if type(result) != list or any(type(item) != dict for item in result):
   96             return []
   97         return convert_to_function_call(result)
   98 
   99     @override
  100     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  101         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  102         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  103 
  104         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  105         # FC models use its own system prompt, so no need to add any message
  106 
  107         return {"message": [], "function": functions}
  108 
  109     @override
  110     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  111         """
  112         Parses the raw response from the model API to extract the result, input token count, and output token count.
  113 
  114         Args:
  115             api_response (any): The raw response from the model API.
  116 
  117         Returns:
  118             A dict containing the following elements:
  119                 - model_responses (any): The parsed result that can be directly used as input to the decode method.
  120                 - input_token (int): The number of tokens used in the input to the model.
  121                 - output_token (int): The number of tokens generated by the model as output.
  122                 - Any other metadata that is specific to the model.
  123         """
  124         model_responses_message_for_chat_history = api_response.choices[0].text
  125         model_responses = api_response.choices[0].text
  126         extracted_tool_calls = self._extract_tool_calls(model_responses)
  127 
  128         if (
  129             self._is_tool_call_response_format(extracted_tool_calls)
  130             and len(extracted_tool_calls) > 0
  131         ):
  132             model_responses = [
  133                 {item["name"]: item["arguments"]} for item in extracted_tool_calls
  134             ]
  135 
  136         return {
  137             "model_responses": model_responses,
  138             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": model_responses_message_for_chat_history,
  139             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
  140             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
  141         }
  142 
  143     @override
  144     def _add_assistant_message_prompting(
  145         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  146     ) -> dict:
  147         """
  148         Add assistant message to the chat history.
  149         """
  150         inference_data["message"].append(
  151             {
  152                 "role": "assistant",
  153                 "content": model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"],
  154             }
  155         )
  156         return inference_data
  157 
  158     @staticmethod
  159     def _extract_tool_calls(input_string: str) -> list[any]:
  160         """
  161         Given some input response, attempt to parse out the tool calls made by the model.
  162 
  163         Args:
  164             input_string (str): The model response
  165 
  166         Returns:
  167             (list) The matched objects that we were able to parse out
  168         """
  169         # Match the normal situation: <|tool_call|>[{\"name\": \"calculate_final_velocity\", \"arguments\": {\"height\": 150, \"initial_velocity\": 0}}]<|/tool_call|>
  170         pattern = r"<\|tool_call\|>(.*?)<\|/tool_call\|>"
  171         matches = re.findall(pattern, input_string, re.DOTALL)
  172 
  173         # Often the model will miss the `<|/tool_call|>`: <|tool_call|>[{\"name\": \"calculate_final_velocity\", \"arguments\": {\"height\": 150, \"initial_velocity\": 0}}]
  174         # Since `<|tool_call|>` is still present, we consider this a valid case
  175         if not matches:
  176             pattern = r"<\|tool_call\|>(.*?)(?:<\|/tool_call\|>)?$"
  177             matches = re.findall(pattern, input_string, re.DOTALL)
  178 
  179         # Process matches into a list of dictionaries
  180         result = []
  181         for match in matches:
  182             # For parallel tool call, Phi might not put them in a list: {\"name\": \"calculate_sales_tax\", \"arguments\": {\"purchase_amount\": 30.45, \"city\": \"Chicago\", \"state\": \"Illinois\"}}, {\"name\": \"calculate_sales_tax\", \"arguments\": {\"purchase_amount\": 52.33, \"city\": \"Sacramento\", \"state\": \"California\"}}, {\"name\": \"calculate_sales_tax\", \"arguments\": {\"purchase_amount\": 11.23, \"city\": \"Portland\", \"state\": \"Oregon\"}}
  183             if not match.startswith("[") and not match.endswith("]"):
  184                 match = "[" + match + "]"
  185 
  186             try:
  187                 match = json.loads(match)
  188             except json.JSONDecodeError:
  189                 pass
  190 
  191             if type(match) is list:
  192                 for item in match:
  193                     # Handle the situation: ['{"name": "random_forest.train", "arguments": {"n_estimators": 100, "max_depth": 5, "data": my_data}}']
  194                     if type(item) == str:
  195                         item = eval(item)
  196                     result.append(item)
  197             else:
  198                 result.append(match)
  199 
  200         return result
  201 
  202     @staticmethod
  203     def _is_tool_call_response_format(input: str) -> bool:
  204         """
  205         This is a helper method to detect if the tool call extracted by `_extract_tool_calls` is actually a tool call.
  206         This is important because the model might return a dictionary that looks like a tool call, but is not. It sometimes returns the function document.
  207         For example,
  208         "<|tool_call|>{\"name\": \"streaming_services.shows_list_and_ratings\", \"arguments\": {\"streaming_service\": \"Netflix\", \"show_list\": [\"Friends\"], \"sort_by_rating\": false}, \"type\": \"dict\", \"description\": \"Get a list of shows and their ratings on Netflix.\"}"
  209         The dictionary will cause the downstream decoding pipeline error, so it's better to do a sanity check here.
  210         """
  211         if type(input) != list:
  212             return False
  213 
  214         for item in input:
  215             if type(item) != dict:
  216                 return False
  217             if "name" not in item:
  218                 return False
  219             if "arguments" not in item:
  220                 return False
  221             if len(item) != 2:
  222                 return False
  223 
  224         return True

   20             messages, add_generation_prompt=True, tokenize=False
   21         )
   22 
   23         return formatted_prompt

    1 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.local_inference.base_oss_handler import OSSHandler
    2 from overrides import override

    4 
    5 class QwenHandler(OSSHandler):
    6     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
    7         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
    8         self.is_fc_model = False
    9 
   10     @override
   11     def _format_prompt(self, messages, function):
   12         """
   13         "chat_template":
   14         {%- if tools %}
   15             {{- '<|im_start|>system\n' }}
   16             {%- if messages[0].role == 'system' %}
   17                 {{- messages[0].content + '\n\n' }}
   18             {%- endif %}
   19             {{- "# Tools\n\nYou may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.\n\nYou are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:\n<tools>" }}
   20             {%- for tool in tools %}
   21                 {{- "\n" }}
   22                 {{- tool | tojson }}
   23             {%- endfor %}
   24             {{- "\n</tools>\n\nFor each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:\n<tool_call>\n{\"name\": <function-name>, \"arguments\": <args-json-object>}\n</tool_call><|im_end|>\n" }}
   25         {%- else %}
   26             {%- if messages[0].role == 'system' %}
   27                 {{- '<|im_start|>system\n' + messages[0].content + '<|im_end|>\n' }}
   28             {%- endif %}
   29         {%- endif %}
   30         {%- set ns = namespace(multi_step_tool=true, last_query_index=messages|length - 1) %}
   31         {%- for message in messages[::-1] %}
   32             {%- set index = (messages|length - 1) - loop.index0 %}
   33             {%- if ns.multi_step_tool and message.role == "user" and message.content is string and not(message.content.startswith('<tool_response>') and message.content.endswith('</tool_response>')) %}
   34                 {%- set ns.multi_step_tool = false %}
   35                 {%- set ns.last_query_index = index %}
   36             {%- endif %}
   37         {%- endfor %}
   38         {%- for message in messages %}
   39             {%- if message.content is string %}
   40                 {%- set content = message.content %}
   41             {%- else %}
   42                 {%- set content = '' %}
   43             {%- endif %}
   44             {%- if (message.role == "user") or (message.role == "system" and not loop.first) %}
   45                 {{- '<|im_start|>' + message.role + '\n' + content + '<|im_end|>' + '\n' }}
   46             {%- elif message.role == "assistant" %}
   47                 {%- set reasoning_content = '' %}
   48                 {%- if message.reasoning_content is string %}
   49                     {%- set reasoning_content = message.reasoning_content %}
   50                 {%- else %}
   51                     {%- if '</think>' in content %}
   52                         {%- set reasoning_content = content.split('</think>')[0].rstrip('\n').split('<think>')[-1].lstrip('\n') %}
   53                         {%- set content = content.split('</think>')[-1].lstrip('\n') %}
   54                     {%- endif %}
   55                 {%- endif %}
   56                 {%- if loop.index0 > ns.last_query_index %}
   57                     {%- if loop.last or (not loop.last and reasoning_content) %}
   58                         {{- '<|im_start|>' + message.role + '\n<think>\n' + reasoning_content.strip('\n') + '\n</think>\n\n' + content.lstrip('\n') }}
   59                     {%- else %}
   60                         {{- '<|im_start|>' + message.role + '\n' + content }}
   61                     {%- endif %}
   62                 {%- else %}
   63                     {{- '<|im_start|>' + message.role + '\n' + content }}
   64                 {%- endif %}
   65                 {%- if message.tool_calls %}
   66                     {%- for tool_call in message.tool_calls %}
   67                         {%- if (loop.first and content) or (not loop.first) %}
   68                             {{- '\n' }}
   69                         {%- endif %}
   70                         {%- if tool_call.function %}
   71                             {%- set tool_call = tool_call.function %}
   72                         {%- endif %}
   73                         {{- '<tool_call>\n{"name": "' }}
   74                         {{- tool_call.name }}
   75                         {{- '", "arguments": ' }}
   76                         {%- if tool_call.arguments is string %}
   77                             {{- tool_call.arguments }}
   78                         {%- else %}
   79                             {{- tool_call.arguments | tojson }}
   80                         {%- endif %}
   81                         {{- '}\n</tool_call>' }}
   82                     {%- endfor %}
   83                 {%- endif %}
   84                 {{- '<|im_end|>\n' }}
   85             {%- elif message.role == "tool" %}
   86                 {%- if loop.first or (messages[loop.index0 - 1].role != "tool") %}
   87                     {{- '<|im_start|>user' }}
   88                 {%- endif %}
   89                 {{- '\n<tool_response>\n' }}
   90                 {{- content }}
   91                 {{- '\n</tool_response>' }}
   92                 {%- if loop.last or (messages[loop.index0 + 1].role != "tool") %}
   93                     {{- '<|im_end|>\n' }}
   94                 {%- endif %}
   95             {%- endif %}
   96         {%- endfor %}
   97         {%- if add_generation_prompt %}
   98             {{- '<|im_start|>assistant\n' }}
   99             {%- if enable_thinking is defined and enable_thinking is false %}
  100                 {{- '<think>\n\n</think>\n\n' }}
  101             {%- endif %}
  102         {%- endif %}
  103         """
  104         formatted_prompt = ""
  105 
  106         if messages[0]["role"] == "system":
  107             formatted_prompt += f"<|im_start|>system\n{messages[0]['content']}<|im_end|>\n"
  108 
  109         last_query_index = len(messages) - 1
  110         for offset, message in enumerate(reversed(messages)):
  111             idx = len(messages) - 1 - offset
  112             if (
  113                 message["role"] == "user"
  114                 and type(message["content"]) == str
  115                 and not (
  116                     message["content"].startswith("<tool_response>")
  117                     and message["content"].endswith("</tool_response>")
  118                 )
  119             ):
  120                 last_query_index = idx
  121                 break
  122 
  123         for idx, message in enumerate(messages):
  124             role = message["role"]
  125             content = message["content"]
  126 
  127             if role == "user" or (role == "system" and idx != 0):
  128                 formatted_prompt += f"<|im_start|>{role}\n{content}<|im_end|>\n"
  129 
  130             elif role == "assistant":
  131                 reasoning_content = ""
  132                 if "reasoning_content" in message and message["reasoning_content"]:
  133                     reasoning_content = message["reasoning_content"]
  134 
  135                 elif "</think>" in content:
  136                     parts = content.split("</think>")
  137                     reasoning_content = (
  138                         parts[0].rstrip("\n").split("<think>")[-1].lstrip("\n")
  139                     )
  140                     content = parts[-1].lstrip("\n")
  141 
  142                 if idx > last_query_index:
  143                     if idx == len(messages) - 1 or reasoning_content:
  144                         formatted_prompt += (
  145                             f"<|im_start|>{role}\n<think>\n"
  146                             + reasoning_content.strip("\n")
  147                             + f"\n</think>\n\n"
  148                             + content.lstrip("\n")
  149                         )
  150                     else:
  151                         formatted_prompt += f"<|im_start|>{role}\n{content}"
  152                 else:
  153                     formatted_prompt += f"<|im_start|>{role}\n{content}"
  154 
  155                 formatted_prompt += "<|im_end|>\n"
  156 
  157             elif role == "tool":
  158                 prev_role = messages[idx - 1]["role"] if idx > 0 else None
  159                 next_role = messages[idx + 1]["role"] if idx < len(messages) - 1 else None
  160 
  161                 if idx == 0 or prev_role != "tool":
  162                     formatted_prompt += "<|im_start|>user"
  163 
  164                 formatted_prompt += f"\n<tool_response>\n{content}\n</tool_response>"
  165 
  166                 if idx == len(messages) - 1 or next_role != "tool":
  167                     formatted_prompt += "<|im_end|>\n"
  168 
  169         formatted_prompt += "<|im_start|>assistant\n"
  170         return formatted_prompt
  171 
  172     @override
  173     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  174         model_response = api_response.choices[0].text
  175 
  176         reasoning_content = ""
  177         cleaned_response = model_response
  178         if "</think>" in model_response:
  179             parts = model_response.split("</think>")
  180             reasoning_content = parts[0].rstrip("\n").split("<think>")[-1].lstrip("\n")
  181             cleaned_response = parts[-1].lstrip("\n")
  182 
  183         return {
  184             "model_responses": cleaned_response,
  185             "reasoning_content": reasoning_content,
  186             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
  187             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
  188         }

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/local_inference/qwen_fc.py
    1 import json
    2 import re

    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.local_inference.base_oss_handler import OSSHandler
    5 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import (
    6     convert_to_function_call,
    7     func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing,
    8 )
    9 from overrides import override
   10 
   11 
   12 class QwenFCHandler(OSSHandler):
   13     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   14         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   15         self.is_fc_model = True
   16         self.model_name_huggingface = model_name.replace("-FC", "")
   17 
   18     @override
   19     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   20         # Model response is of the form:
   21         # "<tool_call>\n{\"name\": \"spotify.play\", \"arguments\": {\"artist\": \"Taylor Swift\", \"duration\": 20}}\n</tool_call>\n<tool_call>\n{\"name\": \"spotify.play\", \"arguments\": {\"artist\": \"Maroon 5\", \"duration\": 15}}\n</tool_call>"?
   22         tool_calls = self._extract_tool_calls(result)
   23         if type(tool_calls) != list or any(type(item) != dict for item in tool_calls):
   24             return []
   25         return [
   26             {call["name"]: {k: v for k, v in call["arguments"].items()}}
   27             for call in tool_calls
   28         ]
   29 
   30     @override
   31     def decode_execute(self, result):
   32         tool_calls = self._extract_tool_calls(result)
   33         if type(tool_calls) != list or any(type(item) != dict for item in tool_calls):
   34             return []
   35         decoded_result = []
   36         for item in tool_calls:
   37             if type(item) == str:
   38                 item = eval(item)
   39             decoded_result.append({item["name"]: item["arguments"]})
   40         return convert_to_function_call(decoded_result)
   41 
   42     @override
   43     def _format_prompt(self, messages, function):
   44         """
   45         "chat_template":
   46         {%- if tools %}
   47             {{- '<|im_start|>system\n' }}

   50             {%- endif %}

   52             {%- for tool in tools %}
   53                 {{- "\n" }}
   54                 {{- tool | tojson }}
   55             {%- endfor %}
   56             {{- "\n</tools>\n\nFor each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:\n<tool_call>\n{\"name\": <function-name>, \"arguments\": <args-json-object>}\n</tool_call><|im_end|>\n" }}
   57         {%- else %}
   58             {%- if messages[0].role == 'system' %}
   59                 {{- '<|im_start|>system\n' + messages[0].content + '<|im_end|>\n' }}
   60             {%- endif %}

   63         {%- for message in messages[::-1] %}
   64             {%- set index = (messages|length - 1) - loop.index0 %}
   65             {%- if ns.multi_step_tool and message.role == "user" and message.content is string and not(message.content.startswith('<tool_response>') and message.content.endswith('</tool_response>')) %}
   66                 {%- set ns.multi_step_tool = false %}
   67                 {%- set ns.last_query_index = index %}
   68             {%- endif %}

   72                 {%- set content = message.content %}

   75             {%- endif %}

   85                         {%- set content = content.split('</think>')[-1].lstrip('\n') %}
   86                     {%- endif %}
   87                 {%- endif %}

   89                     {%- if loop.last or (not loop.last and reasoning_content) %}
   90                         {{- '<|im_start|>' + message.role + '\n<think>\n' + reasoning_content.strip('\n') + '\n</think>\n\n' + content.lstrip('\n') }}
   91                     {%- else %}
   92                         {{- '<|im_start|>' + message.role + '\n' + content }}
   93                     {%- endif %}
   94                 {%- else %}
   95                     {{- '<|im_start|>' + message.role + '\n' + content }}
   96                 {%- endif %}

  104                         {%- endif %}

  109                             {{- tool_call.arguments }}

  112                         {%- endif %}
  113                         {{- '}\n</tool_call>' }}
  114                     {%- endfor %}
  115                 {%- endif %}
  116                 {{- '<|im_end|>\n' }}
  117             {%- elif message.role == "tool" %}
  118                 {%- if loop.first or (messages[loop.index0 - 1].role != "tool") %}
  119                     {{- '<|im_start|>user' }}
  120                 {%- endif %}
  121                 {{- '\n<tool_response>\n' }}

  130             {{- '<|im_start|>assistant\n' }}
  131             {%- if enable_thinking is defined and enable_thinking is false %}
  132                 {{- '<think>\n\n</think>\n\n' }}
  133             {%- endif %}
  134         {%- endif %}
  135         """
  136         formatted_prompt = ""
  137 
  138         if len(function) > 0:
  139             formatted_prompt += "<|im_start|>system\n"
  140             if messages[0]["role"] == "system":
  141                 formatted_prompt += messages[0]["content"] + "\n\n"
  142

  144             for tool in function:
  145                 formatted_prompt += f"\n{json.dumps(tool)}"
  146             formatted_prompt += '\n</tools>\n\nFor each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:\n<tool_call>\n{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}\n</tool_call><|im_end|>\n'
  147 
  148         else:
  149             if messages[0]["role"] == "system":
  150                 formatted_prompt += (
  151                     f"<|im_start|>system\n{messages[0]['content']}<|im_end|>\n"
  152                 )
  153 
  154         last_query_index = len(messages) - 1
  155         for offset, message in enumerate(reversed(messages)):
  156             idx = len(messages) - 1 - offset
  157             if (
  158                 message["role"] == "user"
  159                 and type(message["content"]) == str
  160                 and not (
  161                     message["content"].startswith("<tool_response>")
  162                     and message["content"].endswith("</tool_response>")
  163                 )
  164             ):
  165                 last_query_index = idx
  166                 break
  167 
  168         for idx, message in enumerate(messages):
  169             role = message["role"]
  170             content = message["content"]
  171 
  172             if role == "user" or (role == "system" and idx != 0):
  173                 formatted_prompt += f"<|im_start|>{role}\n{content}<|im_end|>\n"
  174 
  175             elif role == "assistant":
  176                 reasoning_content = ""
  177                 if "reasoning_content" in message and message["reasoning_content"]:
  178                     reasoning_content = message["reasoning_content"]
  179 
  180                 elif "</think>" in content:
  181                     parts = content.split("</think>")
  182                     reasoning_content = (
  183                         parts[0].rstrip("\n").split("<think>")[-1].lstrip("\n")
  184                     )
  185                     content = parts[-1].lstrip("\n")
  186 
  187                 if idx > last_query_index:
  188                     if idx == len(messages) - 1 or reasoning_content:
  189                         formatted_prompt += (
  190                             f"<|im_start|>{role}\n<think>\n"
  191                             + reasoning_content.strip("\n")
  192                             + f"\n</think>\n\n"
  193                             + content.lstrip("\n")
  194                         )
  195                     else:
  196                         formatted_prompt += f"<|im_start|>{role}\n{content}"
  197                 else:
  198                     formatted_prompt += f"<|im_start|>{role}\n{content}"
  199 
  200                 formatted_prompt += "<|im_end|>\n"
  201 
  202             elif role == "tool":
  203                 prev_role = messages[idx - 1]["role"] if idx > 0 else None
  204                 next_role = messages[idx + 1]["role"] if idx < len(messages) - 1 else None
  205 
  206                 if idx == 0 or prev_role != "tool":
  207                     formatted_prompt += "<|im_start|>user"
  208 
  209                 formatted_prompt += f"\n<tool_response>\n{content}\n</tool_response>"
  210 
  211                 if idx == len(messages) - 1 or next_role != "tool":
  212                     formatted_prompt += "<|im_end|>\n"
  213 
  214         formatted_prompt += "<|im_start|>assistant\n"
  215         return formatted_prompt
  216 
  217     @override
  218     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  219         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  220         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  221 
  222         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  223         # FC models use its own system prompt, so no need to add any message
  224 
  225         return {"message": [], "function": functions}
  226 
  227     @override
  228     def _parse_query_response_prompting(self, api_response: any) -> dict:
  229         model_response = api_response.choices[0].text
  230         extracted_tool_calls = self._extract_tool_calls(model_response)
  231 
  232         reasoning_content = ""
  233         cleaned_response = model_response
  234         if "</think>" in model_response:
  235             parts = model_response.split("</think>")
  236             reasoning_content = parts[0].rstrip("\n").split("<think>")[-1].lstrip("\n")
  237             cleaned_response = parts[-1].lstrip("\n")
  238 
  239         if len(extracted_tool_calls) > 0:
  240             model_responses_message_for_chat_history = {
  241                 "role": "assistant",
  242                 "content": "",
  243                 "tool_calls": extracted_tool_calls,
  244             }
  245 
  246         else:
  247             model_responses_message_for_chat_history = {
  248                 "role": "assistant",
  249                 "content": cleaned_response,
  250             }
  251 
  252         return {
  253             "model_responses": cleaned_response,
  254             "reasoning_content": reasoning_content,
  255             "model_responses_message_for_chat_history": model_responses_message_for_chat_history,
  256             "input_token": api_response.usage.prompt_tokens,
  257             "output_token": api_response.usage.completion_tokens,
  258         }
  259 
  260     @override
  261     def _add_assistant_message_prompting(
  262         self, inference_data: dict, model_response_data: dict
  263     ) -> dict:
  264         inference_data["message"].append(
  265             model_response_data["model_responses_message_for_chat_history"],
  266         )
  267         return inference_data
  268 
  269     @staticmethod
  270     def _extract_tool_calls(input_string):
  271         pattern = r"<tool_call>\n(.*?)\n</tool_call>"
  272         matches = re.findall(pattern, input_string, re.DOTALL)
  273 
  274         # Process matches into a list of dictionaries
  275         result = []
  276         for match in matches:
  277             try:
  278                 match = json.loads(match)
  279             except Exception as e:
  280                 pass
  281             result.append(match)
  282         return result

    1 import json

    4 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.utils import func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing

    7 
    8 class SalesforceLlamaHandler(OSSHandler):
    9     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
   10         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   11 
   12     @override
   13     def _format_prompt(self, messages, function):
   14         formatted_prompt = "<|begin_of_text|>"
   15 
   16         system_message = "You are a helpful assistant that can use tools. You are developed by Salesforce xLAM team."
   17         remaining_messages = messages
   18         if messages[0]["role"] == "system":
   19             system_message = messages[0]["content"].strip()
   20             remaining_messages = messages[1:]
   21 
   22         # Format system message with tool instructions
   23         formatted_prompt += "<|start_header_id|>system<|end_header_id|>\n\n"
   24         formatted_prompt += system_message + "\n"
   25         formatted_prompt += "You have access to a set of tools. When using tools, make calls in a single JSON array: \n\n"
   26         formatted_prompt += '[{"name": "tool_call_name", "arguments": {"arg1": "value1", "arg2": "value2"}}, ... (additional parallel tool calls as needed)]\n\n'
   27         formatted_prompt += "If no tool is suitable, state that explicitly. If the user's input lacks required parameters, ask for clarification. "
   28         formatted_prompt += "Do not interpret or respond until tool results are returned. Once they are available, process them or make additional calls if needed. "
   29         formatted_prompt += "For tasks that don't require tools, such as casual conversation or general advice, respond directly in plain text. The available tools are:\n\n"
   30 
   31         for func in function:
   32             formatted_prompt += json.dumps(func, indent=4) + "\n\n"
   33         formatted_prompt += "<|eot_id|>"
   34 
   35         # Format conversation messages
   36         for message in remaining_messages:
   37             if message["role"] == "tool":
   38                 formatted_prompt += "<|start_header_id|>ipython<|end_header_id|>\n\n"
   39                 if isinstance(message["content"], (dict, list)):
   40                     formatted_prompt += json.dumps(message["content"])
   41                 else:
   42                     formatted_prompt += message["content"]
   43                 formatted_prompt += "<|eot_id|>"
   44             elif "tool_calls" in message and message["tool_calls"]:
   45                 formatted_prompt += "<|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>\n\n"
   46                 tool_calls = []
   47                 for tool_call in message["tool_calls"]:
   48                     tool_calls.append(
   49                         {
   50                             "name": tool_call["function"]["name"],
   51                             "arguments": json.loads(tool_call["function"]["arguments"]),
   52                         }
   53                     )
   54                 formatted_prompt += json.dumps(tool_calls) + "<|eot_id|>"
   55             else:
   56                 formatted_prompt += f"<|start_header_id|>{message['role']}<|end_header_id|>\n\n{message['content'].strip()}<|eot_id|>"
   57 
   58         formatted_prompt += "<|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>\n\n"
   59         return formatted_prompt
   60 
   61     @override
   62     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
   63         try:
   64             # Parse the JSON array of function calls
   65             function_calls = json.loads(result)
   66             if not isinstance(function_calls, list):
   67                 function_calls = [function_calls]
   68         except json.JSONDecodeError:
   69             # Fallback for semicolon-separated format
   70             function_calls = [json.loads(call.strip()) for call in result.split(";")]
   71 
   72         decoded_output = []
   73         for func_call in function_calls:
   74             name = func_call["name"]
   75             arguments = func_call["arguments"]
   76             decoded_output.append({name: arguments})
   77 
   78         return decoded_output
   79 
   80     @override
   81     def decode_execute(self, result):
   82         try:
   83             function_calls = json.loads(result)
   84             if not isinstance(function_calls, list):
   85                 function_calls = [function_calls]
   86         except json.JSONDecodeError:
   87             function_calls = [json.loads(call.strip()) for call in result.split(";")]
   88 
   89         execution_list = []
   90         for func_call in function_calls:
   91             name = func_call["name"]
   92             arguments = func_call["arguments"]
   93             execution_list.append(
   94                 f"{name}({','.join([f'{k}={repr(v)}' for k,v in arguments.items()])})"
   95             )
   96 
   97         return execution_list
   98 
   99     @override
  100     def _pre_query_processing_prompting(self, test_entry: dict) -> dict:
  101         functions: list = test_entry["function"]
  102         test_category: str = test_entry["id"].rsplit("_", 1)[0]
  103         functions = func_doc_language_specific_pre_processing(functions, test_category)
  104         # override the default bfcl system prompt, xLAM uses its own system prompt
  105         return {"message": [], "function": functions}

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/local_inference/think_agent.py
    1 import json
    2 
    3 from bfcl_eval.model_handler.local_inference.base_oss_handler import OSSHandler
    4 from overrides import override
    5 
    6 
    7 class ThinkAgentHandler(OSSHandler):
    8     def __init__(self, model_name, temperature) -> None:
    9         super().__init__(model_name, temperature)
   10 
   11     def _convert_functions_format(self, functions):
   12         if isinstance(functions, dict):
   13             return {
   14                 "name": functions["name"],
   15                 "description": functions["description"],
   16                 "parameters": {
   17                     k: v for k, v in functions["parameters"].get("properties", {}).items()
   18                 },
   19             }
   20         elif isinstance(functions, list):
   21             return [self._convert_functions_format(f) for f in functions]
   22         else:
   23             return functions
   24 
   25     def _extract_json_from_text(self, text):
   26         # Split the text at the closing </think> tag and take the part after it
   27         split_text = text.split("</think>", 1)
   28 
   29         # If the split was successful (there was a </think> tag), process the second part
   30         if len(split_text) > 1:
   31             # Strip whitespace from the remaining text to isolate the JSON
   32             json_str = split_text[1].strip()
   33         else:
   34             # Return empty string if no </think> tag found
   35             json_str = "[]"
   36 
   37         return json_str
   38 
   39     @override
   40     def _format_prompt(self, messages, function):
   41         # Think agent is doing the tools_in_user_message approach
   42         """
   43         {{- bos_token }}
   44         {%- if custom_tools is defined %}
   45             {%- set tools = custom_tools %}
   46         {%- endif %}
   47         {%- if not tools_in_user_message is defined %}
   48             {%- set tools_in_user_message = true %}
   49         {%- endif %}
   50         {%- if not date_string is defined %}
   51             {%- if strftime_now is defined %}
   52                 {%- set date_string = strftime_now("%d %b %Y") %}
   53             {%- else %}
   54                 {%- set date_string = "07 Dec 2024" %}
   55             {%- endif %}
   56         {%- endif %}
   57         {%- if not tools is defined %}
   58             {%- set tools = [] %}
   59         {%- endif %}
   60         {#- System message #}
   61         {{- "<|start_header_id|>system<|end_header_id|>" }}
   62         {{- "Cutting Knowledge Date: December 2023" }}
   63         {{- "Today Date: " + date_string + "" }}
   64         {%- if tools is not none and not tools_in_user_message %}
   65             {{- "Given the following functions, please respond with a JSON for a function call with its proper arguments that best answers the given prompt." }}
   66             {{- 'Respond in the format {"name": function name, "parameters": dictionary of argument name and its value}.' }}
   67             {{- "Do not use variables." }}
   68             {{- "Available tools:" }}
   69             {{- tools | tojson(indent=4) }}
   70         {%- endif %}
   71         {{- system_message }}
   72         {{- "<|eot_id|>" }}
   73         {%- if tools_in_user_message and tools|length > 0 %}
   74             {%- if messages | length != 0 %}
   75                 {%- set first_user_message = messages[0]['content']|trim %}
   76                 {%- set messages = messages[1:] %}
   77             {%- else %}
   78                 {{- raise_exception("Cannot put tools in the first user message when there's no first user message!") }}
   79         {%- endif %}
   80             {{- '<|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>' }}
   81             {{- "Given the following functions, please respond with a JSON for a function call with its proper arguments that best answers the given prompt." }}
   82             {{- 'Respond in the format {"name": function name, "parameters": dictionary of argument name and its value}.' }}
   83             {{- "Do not use variables." }}
   84             {{- "Available tools:" }}
   85             {{- tools | tojson(indent=4) }}
   86             {{- first_user_message + "<|eot_id|>"}}
   87         {%- endif %}
   88         {%- for message in messages %}
   89             {%- if not (message.role == 'tool' or 'tool_calls' in message) %}
   90                 {{- '<|start_header_id|>' + message['role'] + '<|end_header_id|>' + message['content'] | trim + '<|eot_id|>' }}
   91             {%- elif 'tool_calls' in message %}
   92                 {%- if not message.tool_calls|length == 1 %}
   93                     {{- raise_exception("This model only supports single tool-calls at once!") }}
   94                 {%- endif %}
   95                 {%- set tool_call = message.tool_calls[0].function %}
   96                 {{- '<|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>' }}
   97                 {{- '{"name": "' + tool_call.name + '", ' }}
   98                 {{- '"parameters": ' }}
   99                 {{- tool_call.arguments | tojson }}
  100                 {{- "}" }}
  101                 {{- "<|eot_id|>" }}
  102             {%- endif %}
  103         {%- endfor %}
  104         {%- if add_generation_prompt %}
  105             {{- '<|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>' }}
  106         {%- endif %}
  107         """
  108         # We first format the function signature and then add the messages
  109         tools = self._convert_functions_format(function)
  110 
  111         formatted_prompt = "<|begin_of_text|>"
  112 
  113         remaining_messages = messages
  114         if messages[0]["role"] == "system":
  115             remaining_messages = messages[1:]
  116 
  117         formatted_prompt += "<|start_header_id|>system<|end_header_id|>"
  118         formatted_prompt += "Cutting Knowledge Date: December 2023"
  119         formatted_prompt += "Today Date: 07 Dec 2024"
  120         formatted_prompt += "<|eot_id|>"
  121 
  122         if len(remaining_messages) > 0:
  123             formatted_prompt += "<|start_header_id|>user<|end_header_id|>"
  124             formatted_prompt += "Given the following functions, please respond with a JSON for a function call with its proper arguments that best answers the given prompt."
  125             formatted_prompt += 'Respond in the format {"name": function name, "parameters": dictionary of argument name and its value}.'
  126             formatted_prompt += "Do not use variables."
  127             formatted_prompt += "Available tools:"
  128             formatted_prompt += f"{tools}"
  129             formatted_prompt += remaining_messages[0]["content"].strip()
  130             formatted_prompt += "<|eot_id|>"
  131 
  132         formatted_prompt += "<|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>"
  133 
  134         return formatted_prompt
  135 
  136     @override
  137     def decode_ast(self, result, language="Python"):
  138         # The output is a list of dictionaries, where each dictionary contains the function name and its arguments
  139         result = result.strip()
  140         result = result.replace("'", '"')  # replace single quotes with double quotes
  141         result = self._extract_json_from_text(result)
  142         result = json.loads(result)
  143 
  144         func_calls = []
  145         for item in result:
  146             function_name = item["name"]
  147             arguments = item["arguments"]
  148             func_calls.append({function_name: arguments})
  149 
  150         return func_calls
  151 
  152     @override
  153     def decode_execute(self, result):
  154         # The output is a list of dictionaries, where each dictionary contains the function name and its arguments
  155         result = result.strip()
  156         result = result.replace("'", '"')  # replace single quotes with double quotes
  157         result = self._extract_json_from_text(result)
  158         result = json.loads(result)
  159 
  160         # put the functions in format function_name(arguments)
  161         function_call_list = []
  162         for item in result:
  163             function_name = item["name"]
  164             arguments = item["arguments"]
  165             function_call_list.append(f"{function_name}({arguments})")
  166 
  167         execution_list = []
  168         for function_call in function_call_list:
  169             for key, value in function_call.items():
  170                 execution_list.append(
  171                     f"{key}({','.join([f'{k}={repr(v)}' for k,v in value.items()])})"
  172                 )
  173         return execution_list

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/parser/__init__.py

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/parser/java_parser.py
    1 from tree_sitter import Language, Parser
    2 import tree_sitter_java
    3 
    4 JAVA_LANGUAGE = Language(tree_sitter_java.language(), "java")
    5 
    6 parser = Parser()
    7 parser.set_language(JAVA_LANGUAGE)
    8 
    9 
   10 def parse_java_function_call(source_code):
   11     tree = parser.parse(bytes(source_code, "utf8"))
   12     root_node = tree.root_node
   13     sexp_result = root_node.sexp()
   14 
   15     if "ERROR" in sexp_result:
   16         raise SyntaxError("Error parsing java the source code.")
   17 
   18     def get_text(node):
   19         """Returns the text represented by the node."""
   20         return source_code[node.start_byte : node.end_byte]
   21 
   22     def traverse_node(node, nested=False):
   23         if node.type == "string_literal":
   24             if nested:
   25                 return get_text(node)
   26             # Strip surrounding quotes from string literals
   27             return get_text(node)[1:-1]
   28         elif node.type == "character_literal":
   29             if nested:
   30                 return get_text(node)
   31             # Strip surrounding single quotes from character literals
   32             return get_text(node)[1:-1]
   33         """Traverse the node to collect texts for complex structures."""
   34         if node.type in [
   35             "identifier",
   36             "class_literal",
   37             "type_identifier",
   38             "method_invocation",
   39         ]:
   40             return get_text(node)
   41         elif node.type == "array_creation_expression":
   42             # Handle array creation expression specifically
   43             type_node = node.child_by_field_name("type")
   44             value_node = node.child_by_field_name("value")
   45             type_text = traverse_node(type_node, True)
   46             value_text = traverse_node(value_node, True)
   47             return f"new {type_text}[]{value_text}"
   48         elif node.type == "object_creation_expression":
   49             # Handle object creation expression specifically
   50             type_node = node.child_by_field_name("type")
   51             arguments_node = node.child_by_field_name("arguments")
   52             type_text = traverse_node(type_node, True)
   53             if arguments_node:
   54                 # Process each argument carefully, avoiding unnecessary punctuation
   55                 argument_texts = []
   56                 for child in arguments_node.children:
   57                     if child.type not in [
   58                         ",",
   59                         "(",
   60                         ")",
   61                     ]:  # Exclude commas and parentheses
   62                         argument_text = traverse_node(child, True)
   63                         argument_texts.append(argument_text)
   64                 arguments_text = ", ".join(argument_texts)
   65                 return f"new {type_text}({arguments_text})"
   66             else:
   67                 return f"new {type_text}()"
   68         elif node.type == "set":
   69             # Handling sets specifically
   70             items = [
   71                 traverse_node(n, True)
   72                 for n in node.children
   73                 if n.type not in [",", "set"]
   74             ]
   75             return "{" + ", ".join(items) + "}"
   76 
   77         elif node.child_count > 0:
   78             return "".join(traverse_node(child, True) for child in node.children)
   79         else:
   80             return get_text(node)
   81 
   82     def extract_arguments(args_node):
   83         arguments = {}
   84         for child in args_node.children:
   85             if child.type == "assignment_expression":
   86                 # For named parameters
   87                 name_node, value_node = child.children[0], child.children[2]
   88                 name = get_text(name_node)
   89                 value = traverse_node(value_node)
   90                 if name in arguments:
   91                     if not isinstance(arguments[name], list):
   92                         arguments[name] = [arguments[name]]
   93                     arguments[name].append(value)
   94                 else:
   95                     arguments[name] = value
   96                 # arguments.append({'name': name, 'value': value})
   97             elif child.type in ["identifier", "class_literal", "set"]:
   98                 # For unnamed parameters and handling sets
   99                 value = traverse_node(child)
  100                 if None in arguments:
  101                     if not isinstance(arguments[None], list):
  102                         arguments[None] = [arguments[None]]
  103                     arguments[None].append(value)
  104                 else:
  105                     arguments[None] = value
  106         return arguments
  107 
  108     def traverse(node):
  109         if node.type == "method_invocation":
  110             # Extract the function name and its arguments
  111             method_name = get_text(node.child_by_field_name("name"))
  112             class_name_node = node.child_by_field_name("object")
  113             if class_name_node:
  114                 class_name = get_text(class_name_node)
  115                 function_name = f"{class_name}.{method_name}"
  116             else:
  117                 function_name = method_name
  118             arguments_node = node.child_by_field_name("arguments")
  119             if arguments_node:
  120                 arguments = extract_arguments(arguments_node)
  121                 for key, value in arguments.items():
  122                     if isinstance(value, list):
  123                         raise Exception(
  124                             "Error: Multiple arguments with the same name are not supported."
  125                         )
  126                 return [{function_name: arguments}]
  127 
  128         else:
  129             for child in node.children:
  130                 result = traverse(child)
  131                 if result:
  132                     return result
  133 
  134     result = traverse(root_node)
  135     return result if result else {}

FILE source/bfcl/bfcl_eval/model_handler/parser/js_parser.py
    1 from tree_sitter import Language, Parser
    2 import tree_sitter_javascript
    3 
    4 JS_LANGUAGE = Language(tree_sitter_javascript.language(), "javascript")
    5 
    6 parser = Parser()
    7 parser.set_language(JS_LANGUAGE)
    8 
    9 
   10 def parse_javascript_function_call(source_code):
   11     # Parse the source code
   12     tree = parser.parse(bytes(source_code, "utf8"))
   13     root_node = tree.root_node
   14     sexp_result = root_node.sexp()
   15     if "ERROR" in sexp_result:
   16         raise SyntaxError("Error js parsing the source code.")
   17 
   18     # Function to recursively extract argument details
   19     def extract_arguments(node):
   20         args = {}
   21         for child in node.children:
   22             if child.type == "assignment_expression":
   23                 # Extract left (name) and right (value) parts of the assignment
   24                 name = child.children[0].text.decode("utf-8")
   25                 value = child.children[2].text.decode("utf-8")
   26                 if (value.startswith('"') and value.endswith('"')) or (
   27                     value.startswith("'") and value.endswith("'")
   28                 ):
   29                     value = value[1:-1]  # Trim the quotation marks
   30                 if name in args:
   31                     if not isinstance(args[name], list):
   32                         args[name] = [args[name]]
   33                     args[name].append(value)
   34                 else:
   35                     args[name] = value
   36 
   37             elif child.type == "identifier" or child.type == "true":
   38                 # Handle non-named arguments and boolean values
   39                 value = child.text.decode("utf-8")
   40                 if None in args:
   41                     if not isinstance(args[None], list):
   42                         args[None] = [args[None]]
   43                     args[None].append(value)
   44                 else:
   45                     args[None] = value
   46         return args
   47 
   48     # Find the function call and extract its name and arguments
   49     if root_node.type == "program":
   50         for child in root_node.children:
   51             if child.type == "expression_statement":
   52                 for sub_child in child.children:
   53                     if sub_child.type == "call_expression":
   54                         function_name = sub_child.children[0].text.decode("utf8")
   55                         arguments_node = sub_child.children[1]
   56                         parameters = extract_arguments(arguments_node)
   57                         for key, value in parameters.items():
   58                             if isinstance(value, list):
   59                                 raise Exception(
   60                                     "Error: Multiple arguments with the same name are not supported."
   61                                 )
   62                         result = [{function_name: parameters}]
   63                         return result
